title: Project Engineer
description:
Position Overview 
 We are seeking highly motivated fresh graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of experience to join our PDS team in Mumbai as Project Engineers. This exceptional learning opportunities in construction project management, providing exposure to high-profile commercial real estate projects for leading multinational clients. You will work alongside experienced project managers and engineers while developing technical and professional competencies essential for a successful career in project management. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Project Delivery Support: You will support the PDS team in delivering construction and fit-out projects across various asset classes. This includes assisting project engineers and managers with day-to-day project coordination, tracking project milestones, and ensuring deliverables are completed according to established timelines. You will gain comprehensive exposure to JLLs project delivery methodologies and governance frameworks. Site Supervision Quality Monitoring: Regular site visits to active construction sites will form a critical part of your learning experience. You will accompany senior team members to commercial office developments, corporate fit-out projects, and other facilities to observe construction activities, understand site management practices, and learn quality control procedures. Responsibilities include documenting site conditions through photographs, noting work progress, identifying quality issues, and assisting in punch list preparation. Technical Documentation Drawing Management: You will assist in reviewing and managing technical documentation including architectural drawings, MEP layouts, structural plans, and specifications. This involves coordinating drawing revisions, maintaining updated drawing registers, tracking submittal logs, and ensuring document version control. You will learn to identify potential clashes or coordination issues across different engineering disciplines. Meeting Coordination Reporting: Supporting the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas, attending project meetings, recording minutes, and tracking action items will develop your project coordination skills. You will help prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, project presentations, and status dashboards for internal teams and client stakeholders. Contractor Vendor Coordination: You will assist in coordinating with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and material suppliers. This includes tracking contractor deliverables, obtaining competitive quotations, maintaining vendor databases, processing material submittals and approvals, and supporting the procurement process under guidance from senior team members. Budget Schedule Tracking: Learning to monitor project budgets and schedules is essential. You will assist in tracking costs against approved budgets, reviewing contractor payment applications, maintaining cost registers, and helping prepare budget variance reports. For schedule management, you will support updating project schedules, tracking critical path activities, and identifying potential delays. Health, Safety Environment (HSE): Understanding and promoting safety culture is paramount. You will participate in site safety inductions, attend safety meetings, assist in conducting safety inspections, and ensure compliance with JLLs HSE policies. You will learn to identify potential hazards and understand corrective action protocols. Client Interaction Relationship Management: Under supervision, you will gain exposure to client interactions, learning professional communication standards and relationship management practices. This includes attending client meetings, understanding client requirements, and delivering service excellence aligned with JLL PDS standards. Continuous Learning Professional Development: Active participation in JLLs training programs, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions is expected. You will have opportunities to learn industry best practices, emerging technologies in construction, and project management tools and techniques. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Recent graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of construction processes, building systems, and engineering principles Familiarity with reading technical drawings and engineering specifications Basic proficiency in AutoCAD (ability to view and understand drawings) Competency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Willingness to learn project management software such as MS Project, Primavera, or similar tools Core Competencies: Strong desire to learn and grow within the project management profession Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi (verbal and written) Detail-oriented with good organizational and time management abilities Ability to work collaboratively in team environments Proactive attitude with problem-solving mindset Adaptability and willingness to take on diverse responsibilities Professional demeanor suitable for client-facing interactions Other Requirements: Willingness to conduct frequent site visits across Mumbai and surrounding areas (MMR region) Flexibility to work on-site as required by project demands Ability to work occasionally beyond standard hours to meet project deadlines 
 
 Location

title: Senior Executive - International Sales
description:
Senior Executive - International Sales Company: ALAN Electronic Systems Private Limited Department: International Sales Location: Head Office, Ambernath, Maharashtra (international travel required) Reporting To: Head of Department - International Sales Experience: 8-12 years Role Overview The Senior Executive - International Sales owns the execution quality of ALANs international sales administration: order processing, export documentation, dispatch, payment collection and partner support. The role leads the Executive and Junior Executive who perform these tasks and is accountable for every activity being completed within the defined timelines. The role also resolves technical issues raised by sales partners on ALAN products, prepares AOP data and presentations, plans and executes the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM), and represents ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences. Key Responsibilities 1. Order Processing Oversight Ensure partner POs are received, verified against the approved price list, discounts, payment terms, and booked in ERP within the defined TAT Review and approve proforma invoices and order confirmations before release to the partner Ensure country-specific requirements are checked before booking: product registration, CE certificate validity, import permits and labelling Review partner credit status and outstanding dues on each order; take exceptions to the HoD for approval Review the order register daily for pending, delayed and incorrectly booked orders 2. Fulfilment and Dispatch Monitoring Monitor order status against committed dates; coordinate with planning, production, stores and QC to remove delays Ensure partners receive revised dates before the due date when delays occur Approve order changes, partial shipments and cancellations; ensure approvals are documented Ensure demo unit, spare parts and sample dispatches follow approved requests 3. Export Documentation and Logistics Review export documents before dispatch: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, CE certificate, conformity documents and partner-specific documents Approve freight forwarder and courier selection based on quotes, transit time and reliability Ensure dispatch intimation and tracking details reach the partner on dispatch day Resolve transit delays, damage and customs queries with the forwarder and partner Ensure statutory export records are complete: shipping bill, bank realization certificate, export incentive and duty claims 4. Payment and Receivables Control Ensure payments are tracked against agreed terms: advance and credit Review partner-wise receivables ageing weekly and report to the HoD Follow up personally on overdue accounts and recommend order hold where required Ensure invoices are closed after confirmed receipt and bank documents are filed 5. Technical Support to Sales Partners Resolve partner and end-user queries on ALAN electrosurgical generators and accessories: setup, operation, settings, compatibility and performance Diagnose reported faults and complaints with the partner, using photographs, videos and error details; guide corrective steps remotely Coordinate with service, QA and D&D when the issue needs repair, replacement or design review Ensure complaints, returns and replacements are logged, investigated and closed with recorded corrective action Identify repeat issues by product and partner; report patterns to QA and the HoD Support partner demos, product training and technical clarifications for tenders and registrations Maintain product technical documents, FAQs and troubleshooting guides for partner use 6. Partner Records and Compliance Ensure partner master data is current: agreements, validity, territory, price lists, registration documents and contacts Track expiry of agreements, product registrations and certificates; initiate renewals in advance Ensure authorization letters, declarations and tender documents requested by partners are issued on time 7. title: Project Manager Transmission & Substation
description:
Company Description 
 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it's improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. Our clients trust us to bring together the best people, ideas, technical expertise and digital solutions to our work in transportation, buildings, water, the environment and new energy. We're one global team - 47,000 strong - driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world. 

 Job Description 
 Job Description AECOM is seeking experienced Project Managers - Transmission Line, HVDC Substation to lead Program Management Consultancy (PMC) services for large-scale transmission infrastructure packages associated with the Khavda Hybrid Renewable Energy Program. The successful candidate will provide overall leadership, governance, coordination and delivery oversight of Transmission Line, HVAC Substation and HVDC Terminal Station packages, ensuring safe, timely and compliant execution in accordance with contractual, technical, quality, environmental and commercial requirements. The role requires extensive experience in Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission systems, multidisciplinary project management, stakeholder coordination and successful delivery of large infrastructure projects from design through energization and handover. Key Responsibilities Project Leadership Governance Serve as the primary interface between the Client, Consultant, EPC Contractors, OEMs and external stakeholders. Establish project governance, communication protocols, reporting structures and responsibility matrices. Lead mobilization and management of PMC resources across transmission line corridors, substations and HVDC terminal facilities. Drive implementation of project execution strategies, monitoring systems and controls to achieve approved project objectives. Ensure effective coordination across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover activities. Project Controls Performance Management Review contractor baseline schedules, resource deployment plans, procurement schedules and commissioning programs. Monitor progress against contractual milestones and project KPIs. Identify delays, constraints and performance gaps and develop recovery and acceleration recommendations. Review and analyze project dashboards, look-ahead plans and progress forecasts. Oversee implementation of project controls, risk management and performance reporting systems. Technical Oversight Review critical engineering deliverables, design submissions and technical proposals. Coordinate interfaces involving transmission lines, substations, HVDC systems, civil works, protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and associated infrastructure. Provide technical guidance on constructability, commissioning readiness, energization planning and operational requirements. Ensure compliance with applicable technical standards, specifications and regulatory requirements. Contract Commercial Management Review contractor claims, variations, change orders and extension of time submissions. Support assessment of contractual obligations, commercial exposures and risk mitigation strategies. Review payment recommendations and milestone achievement certifications. Ensure project records, correspondence and management decisions are properly documented. Quality, HSE Risk Management Ensure implementation of approved Quality Management Systems and Inspection Test Plans. Monitor HSE performance and compliance with project, statutory and client requirements. Lead periodic quality, safety, construction and risk review meetings. Maintain project risk registers, action trackers and mitigation plans. Ensure timely closure of NCRs, punch points and corrective action items. Stakeholder Interface Management Manage coordination with landowners, utilities, statutory authorities, transmission agencies and project stakeholders. Facilitate timely resolution of ROW, access, crossing, outage, land acquisition and interface constraints. Support effective communication between multidisciplinary project teams and external agencies. Provide regular executive-level updates and strategic recommendations to the Client. Completion Handover Lead construction completion reviews, pre-commissioning assessments and energization readiness reviews. Oversee project handover and close-out activities. Ensure completion dossiers, test reports, as-built drawings and project documentation are submitted and accepted. Support transition from construction to operational readiness in accordance with client requirements. 

 Qualifications 
 Education Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. Experience Minimum 15 years of professional experience in transmission and substation infrastructure projects. Proven experience delivering EHV transmission line and substation projects. Demonstrated leadership of at least one major 400 kV or 765 kV transmission or substation project. Experience in large-scale utility, renewable energy or power transmission programs. Experience in multidisciplinary project management and stakeholder coordination. 

 Additional Information 
 Experience with HVDC converter stations and transmission systems. Experience in GIS substations, power transformers, shunt reactors and protection systems. Knowledge of SCADA, telecommunications and grid integration systems. Experience working as PMC, Owner's Engineer, Engineer's Representative or EPC Project Manager. PMP, PMI, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

title: Project Manager HVDC Converter Station, Substation & Overhead
description:
Company Description 
 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it's improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. Our clients trust us to bring together the best people, ideas, technical expertise and digital solutions to our work in transportation, buildings, water, the environment and new energy. We're one global team - 47,000 strong - driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world. Here, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. We will give you the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you're working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion - a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. We will encourage you to grow and develop your career with us through our technical and professional development programs and diverse career opportunities. We believe in leadership at all levels. No matter where you sit in the organization you can make a lasting impact on the projects you work on, the teams and committees you join and our business. We offer competitive pay and benefits, well-being programs to support you and your family, and the development resources you need to advance your career. When you join us, you will connect and collaborate with a global network of experts - planners, designers, engineers, scientists, consultants, program and construction managers - leading the change toward a more sustainable and equitable future. Join us and let's get started. 

 Job Description 
 Job Description AECOM is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead Project Management Consultancy activities for the construction of HVDC converter stations, EHV substations and associated overhead transmission lines. The role will be responsible for planning, coordinating and monitoring project execution on behalf of the client, ensuring that works are delivered safely, within the approved programme and budget, and in accordance with contract requirements, approved designs, quality standards and applicable regulations. The Project Manager will act as the principal interface between the client, EPC contractors, OEMs, consultants and other project stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Project Planning and Delivery Lead project mobilization, construction planning, baseline schedule development and execution strategy. Manage PMC activities across pre-construction, construction, testing, commissioning and project closeout. Review and monitor the EPC contractor's detailed programme, milestone schedule, three-week look-ahead plans and recovery plans. Monitor physical progress against the approved baseline and identify potential delays or critical-path impacts. Review contractor mobilization, site logistics, temporary facilities, resource plans and construction methodologies. Coordinate constructability reviews and ensure approved engineering documents are available before execution. Oversee construction of: HVDC converter station equipment and systems EHV AIS/GIS substations Converter transformers, reactors and filter systems AC and DC switchyards Control, protection, SCADA and telecommunications systems Auxiliary power, earthing and lightning-protection systems Overhead transmission lines, towers, foundations and conductors Support testing, pre-commissioning, energization, performance testing and handover activities. Ensure timely closure of punch points and completion of as-built documentation. Contract and Commercial Management Administer project contracts in coordination with the client's commercial and contract teams. Review contractor compliance with scope, specifications, contractual milestones and deliverables. Assess variations, change requests, extension-of-time submissions and contractor claims. Monitor quantities, payment applications, Schedule of Values and progress certification. Review cost-to-complete forecasts, cash-flow projections and expenditure reports. Identify potential cost overruns and recommend mitigation or value-engineering measures. Maintain appropriate records to support contractual decisions and dispute avoidance. Construction Monitoring and Coordination Coordinate with field supervision, engineering, planning, procurement, quality and HSE teams. Monitor contractor productivity, manpower deployment, plant and equipment availability. Conduct regular progress, interface and coordination meetings. Manage interfaces between converter stations, substations, transmission lines, utilities and external agencies. Review contractor work methods, lifting plans, installation procedures and construction sequencing. Escalate critical issues and recommend corrective or recovery actions. Support resolution of technical queries, RFIs, site instructions and design-interface issues. Quality, Health, Safety and Environment Promote AECOM's commitment to safety, quality and responsible project delivery. Ensure construction activities comply with the approved Project Quality Plan, Inspection and Test Plans and method statements. Monitor compliance with project HSE plans, statutory requirements and client safety standards. Conduct regular site inspections, safety walks and quality surveillance. Review non-conformance reports, corrective-action reports and quality observations. Ensure that material inspections, installation checks and testing records are properly maintained. Support incident investigations and implementation of preventive actions. Promote environmental compliance and sustainable construction practices. Risk and Programme Management Establish and maintain project risk, issue and opportunity registers. Identify schedule, cost, technical, interface, procurement and construction risks. Develop and monitor mitigation measures with relevant project stakeholders. Review contractor recovery schedules and acceleration plans. Provide early warning of potential delays, claims or adverse cost impacts. Support project governance, stage-gate reviews and management reporting. Stakeholder and Client Management Serve as the primary PMC point of contact for the client. Lead project progress meetings with clients, EPC contractors, OEMs and consultants. Provide clear and timely reports on safety, progress, cost, quality, risk and key decisions. Prepare executive dashboards, presentations and management reports. Coordinate with statutory authorities, utility agencies and local stakeholders as required. Maintain strong professional relationships and support effective issue resolution. Represent the client's interests while maintaining fair and transparent contract administration. Team Leadership Lead and coordinate the multidisciplinary PMC site team. Define team responsibilities, reporting lines and communication protocols. Mentor project engineers, construction managers, planners and coordinators. Review team performance, resource requirements and staffing levels. Promote collaboration, accountability and consistent project-management practices. Support recruitment, onboarding and development of project personnel. 

 Qualifications 
 Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline. Minimum 15 years of experience in major power transmission, substation or HVDC infrastructure projects. Demonstrable experience in the construction of HVDC converter stations, EHV substations or overhead transmission lines. Previous experience in PMC, Owner's Engineer, EPC or construction-management roles. Strong knowledge of project planning, contract administration, construction supervision and commissioning. Working knowledge of applicable IS, IEC, IEEE, CEA and utility standards. Proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project and Microsoft Office applications. Strong leadership, communication, reporting and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work at project sites and manage multiple contractors and work fronts Preferred Qualifications PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification. Professional Engineer, Chartered Engineer or equivalent registration. Experience in 500 kV or higher HVDC converter-station projects. Experience in 400 kV, 765 kV or higher-voltage transmission systems. Familiarity with digital project-management and document-control platforms such as Procore, Aconex or equivalent. Experience with FIDIC, EPC, EPCM or similar forms of contract. Formal construction-safety certification such as NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA 30 or equivalent. Core Competencies Project and construction management HVDC converter-station construction EHV substation and transmission-line delivery Programme and progress management Contract and change management Cost and commercial awareness Construction quality assurance HSE leadership Risk and opportunity management Testing and commissioning coordination 

 Additional Information 
 Additional Information The position will be site-based at Khavda or Surat and may require travel between project locations, contractor offices, manufacturing facilities and client offices. The successful candidate will work within a multidisciplinary AECOM Energy team supporting the safe and successful delivery of major HVDC and transmission infrastructure projects At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Job Description Job Description AECOM is seeking a Field Engineer - Transmission Substation with Hybrid Renewable Energy Integration for PMC role to act as the Owner's Representative at site, responsible for supervision, coordination, and quality assurance of EHV transmission lines, GIS/AIS substations, and renewable evacuation infrastructure (solar, wind, and BESS systems). The role ensures that EPC contractors deliver works in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, HSE requirements, and project schedules, while maintaining strong coordination across Electrical, Civil, IC, QA/QC, and HSE disciplines. Core strength lies in site execution oversight, engineering validation, and multidisciplinary coordination, ensuring seamless delivery of transmission, substation, and hybrid renewable energy projects. The role contributes to achieving project objectives in terms of quality, safety, schedule, and regulatory compliance, consistent with AECOM's global standards. Key Responsibilities 1. Site Supervision PMC Oversight Supervise construction, installation, testing, and commissioning of substations (AIS/GIS), transmission lines, and hybrid renewable evacuation systems (33kV-765kV). Ensure adherence to approved drawings, specifications, QAP/FQP, and construction methodologies. Monitor project progress against L2/L3 schedules, identify risks/delays, and support corrective actions in coordination with Project Controls. Maintain daily/weekly progress reports, site documentation, and compliance records. 2. Transmission Line Execution Oversee survey, tower spotting, foundation works (including stub setting), tower erection, and stringing activities. Supervise OPGW installation, sag-tensioning, and alignment with approved profiles and clearances. Coordinate ROW issues, statutory approvals, and stakeholder interfaces. Ensure compliance with technical standards and quality benchmarks for line construction. 3. Substation (GIS/AIS) Execution Supervise installation and commissioning of: Power transformers and reactors GIS/AIS switchgear, bus systems, and auxiliary equipment Protection, control, SCADA/SAS, and metering systems Ensure proper implementation of earthing, lightning protection, and cable systems. Witness pre-commissioning checks, functional testing, and energization activities. 4. Hybrid Renewable Energy Integration (Solar/Wind/BESS) Coordinate grid integration of solar PV plants, wind farms, and hybrid systems. Supervise pooling substations, step-up transformers, and MV/HV cable systems. Support synchronization, grid compliance, and performance validation of renewable assets. 5. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Supervise installation and commissioning of containerized BESS systems, including: Battery modules, PCS, transformers, and EMS/SCADA HVAC systems and fire detection suppression systems Monitor system parameters such as DoD, SOH, RTE, and auxiliary consumption. Ensure compliance with safety standards and operational requirements. 6. HVDC Advanced Grid Systems Support site execution and coordination for HVDC converter stations, including converter transformers, valves, and control systems. Assist in integration of STATCOM, PMU/WAMS, and digital substation technologies. Coordinate with OEM specialists during installation and commissioning. 7. Engineering Review Technical Compliance Review and validate vendor drawings, BOQs, layouts, and technical submissions. Ensure compliance with CEA/CTU/STU regulations, IS/IEC standards, and Grid Code requirements. Verify constructability and alignment of site execution with approved design. 8. Quality Assurance Control (QA/QC) Implement and monitor QAP, FQP, and ITP requirements. Witness and document FAT, SAT, and routine tests. Raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure timely closure. Verify as-built drawings and final documentation for handover. 9. Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Enforce zero-harm safety culture aligned with AECOM and client standards. Conduct safety inspections, toolbox talks, and risk assessments. Ensure compliance with permit-to-work systems, LOTO procedures, and PPE usage. Support incident reporting and corrective action implementation. 10. Interface Management Stakeholder Coordination Act as the interface between Owner, EPC contractors, OEMs, consultants, EPC/Agencies, and utilities. Coordinate across Electrical, Civil, and IC disciplines to resolve site issues. Facilitate inspections, approvals, and statutory clearances. Experience Technical Competencies Proven experience in design and drawing review of GIS substations and EHV XLPE cable systems, preferably within PMC/Owner's Engineer environments. Strong understanding of up to 132kV-765kV GIS/AIS substations, including layouts, clearances, and equipment interfaces. In-depth knowledge of EHV cable systems, including cable sealing ends, routing, jointing, and thermal performance. Sound fundamentals in transmission line engineering, including lattice and monopole towers, foundation systems, profiling, and sag-tension principles. Hands-on capability in reviewing SLDs, layouts, BOQs, cable schedules, earthing layouts, and interface drawings. Experience in technical bid evaluation (TBE), tendering processes, and vendor/OEM coordination. Familiarity with protection systems, SCADA/SAS, and grid compliance requirements. Exposure to QA/QC processes (ITP, FAT, SAT) and HSE practices in construction environments. Strong multidisciplinary coordination and interface management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and stakeholder engagement. Tools Systems Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) Working knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project Familiarity with site reporting and digital monitoring tools Core Competencies Project Execution Control: Schedule tracking (PERT/CPM), progress monitoring, and issue resolution Technical Problem Solving: Ability to resolve site-level engineering challenges Quality Compliance: Strong QA/QC orientation and regulatory adherence Safety Leadership: Commitment to HSE standards and zero-incident culture Stakeholder Management: Effective coordination with EPC contractors and clients Communication: Clear reporting and documentation skills Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electrical / Civil / Instrumentation / Mechanical Engineering Experience Minimum 8+ years in EHV transmission lines and substations (up to 765kV / HVDC) Experience in renewable energy projects (Solar/Wind/BESS integration) is highly desirable Additional Information Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in a matrixed, multicultural, and multidisciplinary environment. Willingness to travel for project reviews, factory visits, and site support. Demonstrates leadership, accountability, and adaptability in complex project environments.

Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
We are looking for a passionateand detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to joinour engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of buildingand scaling our test automation ecosystem owning quality end-to-end, fromtest design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely withdevelopers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust,reliable, and release-ready at all times. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Design, build &maintain scalable automation frameworksusing Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. Own test strategy for assigned squads defining scope, coverage, and riskfrom requirements through production. Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, andProduct stakeholders. Implement TDD practices writing tests before or alongside code to drivequality in development cycles. Integrate automatedsuites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins,GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback. Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web andservices. Identify, document &triage defects with clear reproductionsteps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. Mentor junior QAengineers and champion quality bestpractices across the engineering org. Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps iterating tokeep automation suite trustworthy. 
 
 What We'reLooking For 
 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a productengineering environment. Strong proficiency with SeleniumWebDriver page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. Solid experience with Cucumber(BDD) writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. Hands-on with TestNG test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, andreporting. Working knowledge of TDDprinciples and integrating tests into agile development workflows. Proficiency in at least oneprogramming language Java or Python preferred. Experience with CI/CDintegration and running tests in automated pipelines. Strong analytical thinkingwith an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Excellent communicationskills ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical andnon-technical audiences. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Domain knowledge inPayments understanding of paymentflows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. Familiarity with performance/ load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Exposure to cloudtesting environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). Knowledge of securitytesting basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. Experience with mobileautomation (Appium or similar). 
 
 The Mindset WeValue 
 Beyond technical skills, we hirefor how you think and operate: Ownership mindset you treat quality as your personal responsibility, nota sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and seebugs as a systemic problem to solve. Shift-left thinking you involve yourself in requirements and designdiscussions, not just execution phase. Bias for automation if something is tested manually more than twice, youask how to automate it. Collaborative you work with developers as partners, not adversaries,and build shared ownership of quality. Continuous improvement you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices,improving coverage, speed, and reliability.

The DGM Smart Campus will lead the strategy, design, and execution of Smart Campus IT infrastructure across the organization's campus locations. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of smart campus technologies from strategic planning and vendor selection through deployment, integration, and operations spanning IoT device ecosystems, data center build-outs, network infrastructure, and campus-wide digital systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven program leadership and stakeholder management skills.

Strategy & Planning

IoT & Smart Infrastructure Execution

Program & Vendor Management

¢ Own budgets, timelines, and delivery quality across concurrent smart campus and infrastructure projects.
¢ Build and manage relationships with OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers, and consultants.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
¢ Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning network engineering, IoT/embedded systems, data center operations, and project management.

Governance, Security & Compliance

¢ Own risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for infrastructure projects.
¢ Establish monitoring, incident response, and maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
Required Qualifications

¢ Demonstrated experience leading data center build projects from design through commissioning.
¢ Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or equivalent).
¢ Experience with structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, wireless infrastructure, and data center facilities (power, cooling, redundancy).
¢ Proven track record managing multi-crore/multi-million-dollar infrastructure budgets and large vendor ecosystems.
¢ Familiarity with BMS/BAS integration, physical security systems, and energy management platforms.
¢ Strong project management skills (PMP/PRINCE2 certification preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS (Data Center), CCNP/CCIE, or IoT-specific certifications.
¢ Experience in campus environments (corporate, educational institution, or industrial park).
¢ Exposure to sustainability/green building initiatives (LEED, IGBC) and smart energy systems.
¢ Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for OT/IoT (NIST, ISO 27001).
Key Competencies
¢ Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability
¢ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
¢ Vendor negotiation and contract management
¢ Cross-functional team leadership
¢ Problem-solving under complex, multi-vendor technical environments
¢ Budget ownership and financial acumen

 Technical Skills

 Soft Skills / Ways of Working 
 Detail-oriented test execution — accurate script execution and thorough result documentation 
 Strong analytical mindset for payroll variance identification and documentation

 Ability to work within a defined test schedule and escalate blockers quickly 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Instrumentation Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Project Management Independently manage projects from purchase order receipt to engineering, procurement, manufacturing, inspection, dispatch and final handover. Take complete ownership of project scope, deliverables, cost, quality and delivery commitments. Prepare project execution plans, schedules, milestones and resource requirements. Monitor progress against the approved schedule and proactively resolve delays. Coordinate with design, procurement, production, quality and accounts teams to ensure smooth project execution. 2. Technical Engineering Read and interpret P&IDs, instrumentation drawings, loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, datasheets and technical specifications. Understand project requirements, identify missing information and raise technical queries with customers. Review drawings, BOMs and material requirements for technical compliance before release. Coordinate with design engineers to ensure drawings and documentation meet customer requirements. Identify design errors, scope gaps and potential technical issues before they affect cost or delivery. 3. Project Cost Control Prepare and maintain project-wise budgets covering materials, engineering, labour, subcontracting, testing and other applicable costs. Monitor actual and committed expenditure against the approved budget. Ensure materials are procured as per approved BOMs and project requirements, avoiding excess purchases, wastage and unnecessary inventory. Identify cost overruns, material shortages, design changes and rework at an early stage. Evaluate the cost and schedule impact of changes and obtain the required approvals before implementation. Maintain project cost sheets and provide regular cost-to-complete forecasts. 4. Customer Coordination Act as the primary project contact for assigned customers. Participate in kick-off meetings, technical discussions, progress reviews and inspection meetings. Track customer drawing approvals, technical clarifications, material approvals and other pending inputs. Communicate project status, risks, delays and recovery plans proactively. Manage customer expectations and ensure commitments are realistic and properly documented. 5. Planning and Execution Control Prepare detailed project schedules with activities, responsibilities, target dates and dependencies. Track engineering completion, drawing approvals, material procurement, production, testing and dispatch milestones. Conduct regular internal project review meetings and follow up on pending actions. Identify critical-path activities and take corrective action to prevent delays. Escalate risks early with a clear action plan rather than waiting for management intervention. 6. Quality and Documentation Ensure compliance with customer specifications, approved drawings, inspection plans and applicable standards. Coordinate FAT, customer inspections an d third-party inspections. Ensure timely submission of drawings, datasheets, BOMs, test reports, inspection records and final project documentation. Manage punch points, non-conformities and customer comments through closure. Ensure proper handover of completed project documentation and deliverables. 7. Commercial and Project Closure Track contractual milestones, delivery commitments and customer approval dependencies. Coordinate with sales and accounts teams for billing milestones, dispatch documentation and payment follow-up. Identify additional scope and customer-driven changes requiring commercial approval. Ensure projects are closed with proper documentation, cost reconciliation and lessons learned. Required Skills and Competencies Strong ability to read and interpret P&IDs, instrumentation drawings, wiring diagrams and technical specifications. Proven experience managing instrumentation, electrical panel, automation or EPC projects independently. Good understanding of BOMs, material planning, procurement and manufacturing processes. Strong project scheduling, cost control, risk management and problem-solving skills. Excellent customer communication, coordination and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling tools and preparation of project reports. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet delivery commitments. High ownership, accountability, initiative and decision-making ability. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-time project completion and delivery. Adherence to approved project budgets and cost forecasts. Timely completion of engineering and customer drawing approvals. Reduction in design errors, rework, material wastage and avoidable costs. Timely closure of customer comments, inspection points and documentation. Effective coordination across engineering, procurement, production and quality. Customer satisfaction and successful project handover. Mandatory Candidate Requirement The candidate must have independently managed projects from start to finish, including customer interaction, engineering coordination, project scheduling, material planning, cost monitoring and delivery. Candidates who have only performed design work, prepared drawings or followed instructions without owning project execution will not be suitable for this position. title: Purchase Executive & Sourcing- Casting & Forging Components - Chennai
description:
Senior Executive Purchase & Strategic Sourcing Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 Experience: 7 to 12 Years
 Industry: Automotive / Engineering / Manufacturing
 Function: Purchase, Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Development
 Designation: Senior Manager Purchase & Strategic Sourcing 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Executive Purchase & Strategic Sourcing to lead strategic procurement, sourcing, supplier development, vendor development, localisation and cost optimisation initiatives across a wide range of engineering components. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in sourcing and procurement of Castings, Forgings, Sheet Metal Components, Fabricated Parts, Plastic Components, Rubber Components and Aluminium Die Casting Parts . 
 The role requires strong commercial, technical and supplier-management capabilities, along with experience in local and global sourcing, imports, localisation, cost analysis and supplier negotiations . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Strategic Sourcing 
 Develop and implement strategic sourcing strategies for direct materials and engineering components. Identify, evaluate and develop reliable domestic and international suppliers. Drive sourcing decisions based on cost, quality, delivery, capacity and technology . Conduct RFQs, technical-commercial evaluations and supplier negotiations. Develop long-term sourcing strategies aligned with business and product requirements. 
 2. Supplier & Vendor Development 
 Identify potential suppliers for Castings, Forgings, Sheet Metal, Fabrication, Plastics, Rubber and Aluminium Die Casting components. Lead supplier development activities from supplier identification through qualification and SOP. Conduct supplier capability assessments, audits and commercial evaluations. Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams for supplier approval and development. Improve supplier performance in terms of Quality, Cost and Delivery (QCD) . 
 3. Costing & Cost Optimisation 
 Develop and validate should-cost models for various components. Analyse raw material, conversion, tooling, machining, processing, overhead and logistics costs. Conduct cost benchmarking and identify cost-reduction opportunities. Lead annual cost negotiations and VA/VE initiatives. Drive cost savings through alternate sourcing, process optimisation, localisation and supplier competition. 
 4. Imports & Global Sourcing 
 Manage sourcing of components and raw materials from international suppliers. Evaluate import versus local sourcing economics. Coordinate with suppliers, logistics partners and internal stakeholders for import procurement. Ensure effective management of lead times, landed cost, customs, freight and commercial terms . Identify opportunities for global sourcing while maintaining supply-chain reliability. 
 5. Localisation 
 Develop localisation strategies for imported components. Identify and develop suitable domestic suppliers for localisation projects. Drive localisation from supplier identification development trials validation approval SOP . Track localisation savings and ensure achievement of project timelines and targets. 
 6. Supplier Performance Management 
 Monitor supplier performance through QCD metrics. Develop corrective action plans for underperforming suppliers. Work with suppliers to improve capacity, productivity, quality and delivery performance. Develop alternate and backup sources for critical components. Maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring commercial competitiveness. 
 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Finance and New Product Development teams. Participate in new product development and design reviews from a sourcing perspective. Support DFM/DFA initiatives and identify opportunities for cost-effective manufacturing processes. Ensure sourcing activities are aligned with project timelines and production requirements. 
 Component / Commodity Experience Required 
 Candidates should have strong sourcing experience in multiple categories, preferably: 
 Castings Ferrous & Non-Ferrous Forgings Sheet Metal Components Fabricated Components Plastic Injection Moulded Components Machined Precision Components Tooling, Dies and Fixtures 
 Candidate Profile 
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering or equivalent. 7 12 years of experience in Purchase, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Development or Procurement within Automotive, Engineering or Manufacturing industries. Strong experience in sourcing engineering components and working with manufacturing suppliers. Should possess excellent negotiation, analytical, commercial and supplier-management skills . Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and component costing. Experience handling both domestic and international suppliers is highly desirable. Exposure to ERP systems and procurement tools is preferred. 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 Annual procurement cost savings Localisation savings and percentage Supplier development and qualification timelines Supplier Quality and Delivery performance Import cost optimisation New supplier development VA/VE savings Procurement lead-time reduction Alternate source development Supplier capacity and risk management

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

description:
Job Position : Senior Exhibition Stand Construction & Project Manager Job Location: India Travel: Regular travel to Germany and other European countries
 Experience: Minimum 10 years
 Salary: 12-24 LPA
 Employment Type: Full-time
 
 About the Role Our Germany-based office is looking for an experienced, hands-on professional to manage the technical planning, fabrication and construction of exhibition stands for trade fairs (Messe) in Germany and across Europe. The primary responsibility is to turn existing designs and concepts into high-quality, practical and cost-effective exhibition stands. The candidate will coordinate with designers, workshops, suppliers and European installation teams to ensure that stands are manufactured, transported, assembled and dismantled successfully. 
 Key Responsibilities Translate existing exhibition stand designs into detailed technical and fabrication drawings, production plans and assembly instructions. Manage stand construction, including carpentry, joinery, metal fabrication, CNC cutting, lighting and finishing. Select suitable materials and optimise construction methods, costs and production time. Prepare bills of materials, cost estimates and project budgets. Coordinate fabrication workshops, suppliers, logistics and installation teams. Ensure quality, structural stability, safe installation and compliance with applicable German and European exhibition venue requirements. Supervise on-site stand assembly and dismantling in Germany and other European countries when required. 
 Requirements Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in exhibition stand construction, fabrication or exhibition project execution. Strong practical knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, CNC machinery and technical drawings. Experience converting designs into finished, ready-to-install exhibition stands. Ability to independently manage projects from technical planning through fabrication to final installation. Good English communication, organisational and cost-management skills. Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe. 
 Experience working with German or European trade fairs and contractors is a strong advantage. Knowledge of AutoCAD, SketchUp and other technical drawing tools is preferred. 
 How to Apply Please submit your CV, photographs or a portfolio of completed exhibition stands, details of at least three projects personally managed, current salary, expected salary and notice period. 
 Important: We are looking for a practical construction and execution specialistnot primarily a graphic designer, 3D visualiser or event coordinator. The ideal candidate knows how to take a design created by someone else and turn it into a professionally built exhibition stand.

 Permanent - Full time About Us 
 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the worlds largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

This role supports the end-to-end development of digital catalogues used in Interior Design for Space Planning of residential and commercial environments.

Author detailed product metadata including attributes, materials, finishes, dimensions, pricing, and feature sets in a standardized, structured format. Good aptitude, geometry, visual and drawing skills. Knowledge of MS Excel and other productivity tools. Strong understanding of geometry, 3D visualization. Good analytical and communication skills. Familiarity with interior design standards and product specifications. Good to have - 3D modelling skills (Blender, 3ds Max, AutoCAD etc.). 
 Working for Us

Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.
