title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager - SCM
description:
Job Title: Senior Executive/Assistant Manager - Supply Chain Management (SCM) Department: Supply Chain Management / Planning Reports To: Head - Planning Location: Chakan, Pune Employment Type: Full-Time Grade/Level: Assistant Manager Job Purpose This position is responsible for supply planning, coordinating Drug Product (DP) filling schedules, and packing material planning, to ensure uninterrupted production, packing, and dispatch timelines. The role requires close coordination with Production, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Warehouse, Procurement, and Finance functions, and works within the framework of cGMP and applicable regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Supply Planning - Prepare and maintain rolling supply plans (monthly/quarterly) for DP filling and packing operations in line with sales forecast, production capacity, and inventory targets. - Participate in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions; provide inputs on DP filling and packing material readiness against the demand plan. - Monitor supply-demand gaps for critical raw materials, packing materials, and filling capacity; highlight risks and propose mitigation plans. - Coordinate with Production, Procurement, and Logistics to align supply plans with material availability and dispatch schedules. - Maintain safety stock/buffer norms for critical packing materials and components to safeguard against supply disruptions. - Track plan-versus-actual performance (fill rate, schedule adherence) and drive corrective actions for deviations. - Support annual budgeting and capacity planning exercises with supply-side inputs. - Prepare and circulate periodic supply planning reports/dashboards to the Head - Planning and senior management. 2. DP (Drug Product) Filling - Planning & Coordination - Prepare, update, and maintain DP filling schedules in coordination with Production, QA, and QC to meet batch release and dispatch timelines. - Track filling line capacity and utilization; proactively flag risks of schedule slippage and coordinate re-planning with stakeholders. - Liaise with Production and Warehouse teams to ensure timely availability of drug substance, components, and consumables required for filling batches. - Monitor batch progress against the plan and circulate daily/weekly status updates to the Head - Planning and cross-functional teams. - Coordinate with QA on batch documentation, release timelines, and any deviations affecting the filling plan. - Support capacity planning and scheduling for new products/technology transfers on the filling line. 3. Packing Material Planning & Procurement - Plan and procure primary and secondary packing materials (vials, stoppers, seals/caps, cartons, labels, package inserts, shippers, etc.) in line with production plans and inventory norms. - Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable vendors for packing materials; negotiate pricing, lead times, and payment terms. - Release and follow up purchase orders; track vendor delivery performance and resolve supply escalations. - Maintain optimum inventory levels of packing materials to avoid stock-outs or excess inventory; monitor min-max/safety stock levels and reorder points. - Coordinate with QA and Warehouse for incoming material inspection, approval, and handling of deviations/rejections. - Ensure procurement activities comply with cGMP, vendor qualification, and applicable regulatory documentation requirements. 4. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting - Work closely with Production, QA, QC, Warehouse, Procurement, and Finance to ensure smooth material flow, invoice processing, and payment closure. - Maintain accurate MIS/trackers for supply plans, DP filling schedules, and packing material stock and procurement status. - Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits with relevant SCM documentation and records. - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning accuracy, vendor reliability, and procurement cost efficiency. - Escalate critical supply or schedule risks to the Head - Planning in a timely manner. Qualification & Experience - Graduate / B.Pharm (M.Pharm or MBA in Operations/Supply Chain Management preferred). - 4-6 years of relevant experience in supply chain, supply planning, and/or procurement, preferably within a pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. - Prior exposure to injectable/Drug Product (DP) filling operations and packing material procurement will be an added advantage. Key Skills & Competencies - Working knowledge of cGMP, regulatory, and quality requirements applicable to pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical manufacturing. - Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP or similar) and MS Excel for supply planning, procurement, and inventory tracking. - Strong analytical and forecasting skills for supply-demand planning. - Strong vendor management, negotiation, and commercial acumen. - Effective cross-functional coordination and communication skills. - Ability to work under tight timelines in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Reporting Relationship - Reports To: Head - Planning - This role does not currently have direct reportees.

Key Skills: SAP,Biopharma,Sales,Injectables,Inventory management,SCM,Management,CGMP

description:
Procurement & Cost Control Manager Australian Hospitality Group Company: KVMN Group
 Location: Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 Experience: Minimum 3 Years (Mandatory)
 Employment: Full-Time | Work From Office About the Opportunity KVMN Group, a growing Australian hospitality business group operating multiple pubs, bars, restaurants and breweries across Perth, Western Australia, is seeking a highly intelligent, analytical and commercially focused Procurement & Cost Control Manager for our Ahmedabad office. We are not looking for someone who simply raises purchase orders or places orders with suppliers. We need a sharp negotiator, analytical thinker and commercially minded professional who knows how to challenge supplier pricing, identify unnecessary spending, track product costs and deliver measurable savings. Your primary responsibility will be simple: Reduce our cost of goods without compromising product quality, consistency or operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities 1. Supplier Negotiation & Cost Reduction Negotiate aggressively and professionally with suppliers to secure competitive pricing, rebates, discounts and favourable trading terms. Continuously compare supplier prices and identify cost-saving opportunities. Source alternative suppliers and equivalent products without compromising quality. Challenge unnecessary price increases and negotiate better commercial agreements. Build strong supplier relationships while protecting company profitability. 2. Product Price Tracking & Analytics Develop and maintain a centralised purchasing price database for all products across our hospitality venues. Track individual SKU prices, historical purchase costs, supplier changes and price fluctuations. Identify products with unusual price increases and investigate discrepancies. Compare identical products purchased across different venues to ensure competitive and consistent pricing. Analyse purchasing trends, supplier performance and category-wise expenditure. Build advanced Excel dashboards and management reports to highlight savings opportunities. 3. Hospitality Cost of Goods Management Monitor and analyse food, beverage, liquor and other hospitality purchasing costs. Work with venue managers, chefs and operations teams to identify opportunities to reduce COGS. Analyse high-volume and high-value purchasing categories to prioritise savings. Identify purchasing inefficiencies, unnecessary expenditure, product duplication and avoidable wastage. Recommend product substitutions, bulk purchasing opportunities and supplier consolidation where commercially beneficial. Support improvements in gross profit margins across all hospitality venues. 4. Purchasing Controls & Supplier Management Review supplier invoices, purchase prices and agreed contract rates. Identify incorrect charges, pricing discrepancies and missed discounts. Maintain supplier price lists, purchasing agreements and negotiation records. Establish purchasing approval processes and cost-control procedures. Monitor supplier reliability, delivery performance and product quality. Ensure purchasing decisions are supported by accurate commercial analysis. 5. Reporting & Business Intelligence Prepare weekly and monthly purchasing analysis reports for senior management. Report achieved cost savings against previous purchasing prices. Develop supplier comparison sheets, price movement reports and spending dashboards. Use Excel, Power BI or similar analytical tools to identify cost reduction opportunities. Present clear recommendations backed by numbers, calculations and commercial reasoning. Candidate Requirements Minimum 3 years of relevant procurement, purchasing, supply chain or cost-control experience is mandatory. We are looking for candidates with: Exceptional negotiation and supplier bargaining skills. Strong analytical and numerical ability. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP and data analysis. Proven experience in reducing purchasing costs and improving margins. Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving ability. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Confidence to challenge supplier quotations and negotiate independently. Experience managing supplier pricing, contracts and purchasing data. High attention to detail and ability to identify even small pricing discrepancies. Ability to work independently and take ownership of measurable cost savings. Preferred Experience: Procurement experience in hotels, restaurants, pubs, bars, catering or food and beverage businesses. Food and liquor purchasing experience. Experience working with Australian or international suppliers. Power BI, inventory systems or ERP software experience. Multi-location or multi-branch purchasing experience. What We Offer Opportunity to manage procurement cost analysis for multiple Australian hospitality venues. Direct interaction with Australian business owners and senior management. High level of independence and decision-making responsibility. International business exposure. Competitive salary based on experience and capability. Long-term career development opportunities. Opportunity to demonstrate your value through measurable financial savings. Important – Who Should Apply? We want candidates who can think commercially, negotiate confidently, analyse data accurately and consistently find ways to save money. If you simply process purchase orders without questioning prices, this role is not suitable for you. If you enjoy finding better deals, analysing supplier costs, negotiating prices and improving profitability, we want to hear from you. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience is mandatory. Freshers will not be considered. Office Location: Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Apply with your updated CV and examples of purchasing cost savings achieved in your previous roles.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
## Key Responsibilities

### Business & Sales Performance

* Own and drive the overall sales and business performance of the assigned cluster.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets across the cluster.
* Monitor store-wise sales, conversion, average transaction value, productivity, and other key retail KPIs.
* Identify gaps in store performance and implement effective action plans.
* Drive business growth through local market opportunities, customer initiatives, and sales strategies.
* Ensure consistent achievement of store and cluster-level targets.

### Multi-Store Retail Operations

* Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple Just In Time stores across Ahmedabad.
* Conduct regular store visits to ensure operational discipline and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure consistent execution of SOPs, visual merchandising, grooming, customer service, and brand standards.
* Monitor store hygiene, presentation, processes, and compliance.
* Coordinate with HO teams including HR, Operations, VM, Inventory, Finance, and Marketing to resolve store-level challenges.
* Support new store launches and ensure smooth operational setup.

### Store Manager Leadership

* Lead, coach, and mentor Store Managers across the assigned cluster.
* Set clear performance expectations and review Store Manager performance regularly.
* Develop Store Managers into strong business and people leaders.
* Identify capability gaps and coordinate with the training team for development interventions.
* Ensure Store Managers effectively manage their teams, targets, customer experience, and store operations.
* Build a strong performance-driven culture across the cluster.

### Manpower & Team Management

* Ensure adequate manpower availability across stores in coordination with HR and Talent Acquisition.
* Support manpower planning based on store productivity and business requirements.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, attrition, and retention.
* Identify high-potential employees and support internal career development.
* Ensure effective onboarding and training of new team members.

### Customer Experience

* Ensure a consistently premium customer experience across all stores.
* Monitor customer feedback and address escalated customer concerns.
* Ensure teams maintain high standards of grooming, product knowledge, selling skills, and customer engagement.
* Drive customer retention and relationship-building initiatives.

### Inventory & Store Controls

* Monitor stock availability and ensure optimum inventory levels across stores.
* Coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams for stock movement and requirements.
* Monitor stock ageing, fast-moving and slow-moving products, and inventory-related gaps.
* Ensure adherence to company processes related to stock, cash, billing, and store controls.
* Identify and escalate operational risks or discrepancies promptly.

### Market & Competitor Understanding

* Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
* Understand the competitive retail environment across Ahmedabad.
* Identify opportunities for improving store performance and strengthening Just In Time's market presence.
* Share relevant market insights and recommendations with senior management.

### Reporting & Review

* Prepare and present regular cluster performance updates to senior management.
* Track store-wise sales, targets, productivity, manpower, conversion, inventory, and other relevant KPIs.
* Conduct regular reviews with Store Managers and follow up on agreed action plans.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations for improving cluster performance.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in retail sales and operations.
* Strong experience in managing multiple stores / a retail cluster.
* Experience managing and developing Store Managers and large retail teams.
* Proven experience in achieving sales targets and improving store productivity.
* Strong understanding of retail KPIs, sales conversion, ATV, UPT, productivity, and customer experience.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong analytical and business acumen.
* Experience in premium/luxury retail, watches, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or other high-value retail categories will be preferred.
* Willingness to travel across Ahmedabad and nearby locations as required.

## Key Success Measures

* Cluster sales achievement
* Store-wise target achievement
* Store productivity and conversion
* Average Transaction Value (ATV) and UPT
* Store Manager performance
* Customer experience and service standards
* Team stability and attrition
* Inventory and operational controls
* New store launch and ramp-up performance

About the Role THE SWAYAMVAR is looking for a target-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to manage multiple retail stores and drive sales growth, store profitability, team productivity, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail sales management, multi-store operations, team leadership, and sales performance analysis. Track competitor activities, pricing, promotions, and market trends. Coordinate with the Head Office, HR, MIS, warehouse, and other departments. Proficiency in sales reporting and MIS analysis. Strong communication, problem-solving, and execution skills. Knowledge of retail POS/ERP systems; experience with Ginesys is an advantage. Willingness to travel extensively across assigned stores. Experience & Industry Preference 5-8 years of retail sales experience. At least 2-3 years of experience managing multiple stores or territories. Preferred industries: Fashion, ethnic wear, apparel, lifestyle, and organised retail. Experience in mens ethnic wear and Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs) will be an added advantage. title: Software Test Engineer
description:
About the Role Webnyay Private Limited is looking for a skilled QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise applications. The candidate will work closely with developers, technical leads, product teams, and UI/UX designers to validate application functionality and deliver high-quality software. The ideal candidate should have experience in manual testing, API testing, database validation, test case design, and automation testing, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Key Responsibilities Manual and Functional Testing Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing. Identify, document, track, and verify software defects. Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules. Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios. 
 API and Database Testing Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools. Validate API requests, responses, status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling. Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL. Verify data consistency across application modules and integrations. Test API integrations with third-party and enterprise systems. 
 Automation Testing Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools. Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Identify opportunities to improve test coverage and reduce manual testing effort. 
 Performance, Security and Quality Support performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter or similar platforms. Validate role-based access control, authentication, authorization, and session management. Identify potential application security issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution. Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews. Prepare test reports, maintain test documentation, and communicate quality risks to stakeholders. 
 Team Collaboration Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and technical leads. Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Support UAT, production validation, and release testing. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 28 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and the SDLC/STLC. Hands-on experience with manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing. Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL. Understanding of test case design, defect lifecycle, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira. Experience with test management and documentation. Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Good to Have Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or other automation frameworks. Knowledge of Python, Java, or JavaScript for test automation. Experience with JMeter or other performance testing tools. Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and application security testing. Experience testing enterprise applications, REST APIs, and complex business workflows. Exposure to BFSI, government, legal technology, or regulated enterprise applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 What We Offer Opportunity to work on enterprise-grade applications and real-world business use cases. Collaboration with an experienced engineering and product team. Exposure to API-driven systems, enterprise integrations, and modern application architectures. Opportunity to contribute to product quality and continuous improvement.

title: Vice President Supply Chain Management
description:
Job Description: VP / Head Supply Chain Management (SCM) 
 Role Overview To support our network expansion to 11 tertiary care units, we are looking for a highly strategic VP / Head Supply Chain Management (SCM) . In this role, you will consolidate and centralize procurement operations for the entire group. You will lead high-value capital equipment negotiations (MRIs, Cath Labs, Linear Accelerators), optimize pharmacy supply chains, and build a zero-failure logistics network across all locations to improve operating margins. 
 Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) Strategic Global & Domestic Procurement: Lead multi-million dollar vendor negotiations for high-end medical equipment, implants, surgical consumables, and high-turnover pharmaceuticals. Group Economies of Scale: Centralize the purchase structure across all 11 locations to leverage group-level volumes and aggressively drive down the cost-to-income ratio. Cold Chain & Perishable Logistics: Establish an absolute zero-failure cold chain grid and inventory management protocol for sensitive medical stocks, blood products, and pharmacy requirements. Inventory Control & Warehousing: Enforce strict warehouse automation and audit controls (e.g., Just-in-Time, ABC-VED analysis) to optimize working capital and minimize stockouts or expiries. Technology-Driven SCM Integration: Implement automated supply chain management modules integrated directly with the hospital's central ERP to allow real-time demand tracking. Candidate Profile 
 Experience: 12–15 years in complex logistics and procurement operations, with at least 5 years managing centralized supply chains for a large multi-specialty hospital group or corporate pharmacy/diagnostic network. 
 Education: Degree in Engineering / Pharmacy, paired with an MBA in Supply Chain Management or Operations from a reputable institute. 
 Competencies: Master negotiator, expert level proficiency in automated ERP supply chain modules, and strict adherence to anti-corruption and compliance policies.

Key Skills: Supply chain management,Procurement,Supply chain,Supply,Management

title: Purchase Executive / Asst. Manager / Manager
description:
About Intensiv-Filter Himenviro Intensiv-Filter Himenviro (IFH) is a clean-air technology company with more than 100 years of filtration expertise, dating back to 1922. We design, manufacture, install and service industrial air pollution control equipment, including bag filters, reverse air baghouses, electrostatic precipitators and hybrid filters, for cement, steel, power, chemical, food and other process industries, with teams in India and Germany and customers worldwide. 
 About the role You will handle day-to-day procurement for our manufacturing and project requirements: sourcing, comparing quotations, placing orders and following up with vendors until the material arrives. A good knowledge of sheet-metal components is important. The role involves regular visits to vendors in the Delhi NCR area. 
 Key responsibilities Handle purchase activities for project, engineering and plant requirements on new and ongoing projects. Float purchase enquiries to vendors, collect quotations and prepare comparative statements with price and cost analysis. Negotiate with vendors and place purchase orders after approval. Prepare and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately, with correct specifications, quantities and delivery dates. Follow up with vendors against delivery dates and expedite where material is at risk of delay. Ensure uninterrupted supply of the right material, in the right quality and quantity, at the right time. Review vendor terms and agreements to secure good price and quality. Identify and develop new vendors for sheet-metal components and other regular requirements. Coordinate with project, stores, quality and accounts teams on delivery, quality and payment issues. Verify vendor invoices against orders and receipts, and forward them for payment. 
 What success looks like Material reaches the plant when production needs it. Orders are placed on properly compared quotations at competitive prices. Purchase orders are accurate and rarely need correction. Vendors are followed up before a delay becomes a shortage. 
 What you bring Essential Diploma, B.E. / B.Tech or Graduate degree. 6-11 years of experience in purchase / procurement in manufacturing or sheet-metal industries. Good knowledge of sheet-metal components and items. Ability to compare quotations, negotiate and follow up persistently with vendors. Working knowledge of MS Excel and accurate documentation. Ability to travel locally for frequent vendor visits. 
 Preferred Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering. Experience with ERP-based purchasing. Existing knowledge of sheet-metal and fabrication vendors in Delhi NCR. Ability to read basic drawings and bills of material. 
 Behavioural requirements Persistence Follows up with vendors until the material actually arrives. 
 Integrity Deals with vendors fairly and transparently. 
 Accuracy Gets specifications, quantities and dates right the first time. 
 Responsiveness Keeps production and projects informed of what is coming and when. 
 Why join IFH A solid grounding in procurement for engineered, project-based manufacturing. Exposure to a wide range of materials, from sheet metal to bought-out equipment. Daily interaction with production, projects and vendors.

title: Administration Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Admin Manager to oversee administrative operations across our corporate office and plant location in Delhi NCR. The candidate will be responsible for facility management, infrastructure maintenance, vendor management, security, housekeeping, transport, employee facilities, statutory compliance coordination, and administrative budgeting. The role requires effective coordination with HR, Finance, Procurement, Plant Operations, and other departments to ensure smooth, cost-effective, and compliant administrative operations. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 1. Corporate & Plant Administration Manage day-to-day administrative operations at corporate and plant locations. Ensure smooth functioning of office facilities, plant infrastructure, and employee amenities. Develop and implement administrative policies, procedures, and standard operating practices. Conduct regular facility inspections and ensure timely resolution of administrative issues. 2. Facility & Infrastructure Management Oversee maintenance of office premises, plant buildings, electrical systems, plumbing, air conditioning, and other infrastructure. Manage preventive maintenance schedules and coordinate repairs with relevant vendors and internal teams. Ensure proper upkeep of meeting rooms, workstations, common areas, washrooms, pantry, and plant facilities. Coordinate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for equipment, utilities, and facility-related services. 3. Housekeeping & Pantry Management Supervise housekeeping, pantry, and facility-support staff across locations. Ensure cleanliness, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace discipline. Monitor pantry supplies, drinking water, refreshments, and other employee facilities. Establish service standards and conduct periodic inspections to maintain quality. 4. Security & Safety Coordination Manage security personnel, visitor management, access control, and entry/exit procedures. Coordinate deployment and monitoring of security guards at corporate and plant locations. Ensure proper maintenance of visitor registers, security logs, and incident reports. Coordinate with the EHS and plant teams on fire safety, emergency preparedness, and workplace safety requirements. 5. Vendor & Contract Management Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage vendors for housekeeping, security, transport, maintenance, and other administrative services. Manage vendor agreements, service-level expectations, quotations, and renewals. Monitor vendor performance, service quality, and adherence to agreed timelines. Coordinate vendor bills, service confirmations, and invoice processing with the Finance team. 6. Transport & Travel Management Manage employee transportation, vehicle allocation, and official travel arrangements, wherever applicable. Coordinate vehicle maintenance, fuel expenses, driver deployment, and transport vendor services. Ensure proper maintenance of vehicle documents, insurance, permits, and related records. Optimize transport utilization and control associated costs. 7. Administrative Budgeting & Cost Control Prepare and monitor the administrative budget for corporate and plant locations. Track expenses related to maintenance, housekeeping, security, utilities, transport, and office supplies. Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality. Maintain expense records, prepare MIS reports, and share periodic updates with management. 8. Procurement & Inventory Management Manage procurement of stationery, office supplies, pantry materials, furniture, and other administrative requirements. Maintain inventory records, stock registers, and minimum stock levels. Coordinate with the Purchase and Finance teams for purchase requisitions, approvals, and invoice processing. Ensure timely availability and proper utilization of administrative assets and consumables. 9. Employee Facilities & General Services Ensure availability of essential employee facilities at corporate and plant locations. Coordinate seating arrangements, office shifting, workstation allocation, and facility requirements for new joiners. Support HR in employee engagement activities, celebrations, meetings, and other organizational events. Address employee concerns related to administrative services and ensure timely resolution. 10. Statutory Documentation & Compliance Coordination Maintain administrative records, vendor documents, service agreements, licenses, and facility-related documentation. Coordinate renewals of applicable registrations, permits, and licenses with the relevant internal teams and external agencies. Support compliance with applicable fire safety, building, environmental, and other location-specific requirements. Coordinate inspections, audits, and documentation requirements with relevant stakeholders. 11. Asset & Records Management Maintain an updated register of office furniture, equipment, vehicles, and other administrative assets. Monitor asset allocation, movement, repair, and disposal records. Ensure proper documentation and accountability for company-owned assets. Maintain organized administrative files and records for audits and management reviews. 12. Team Management & Reporting Lead and supervise administrative staff, security personnel, housekeeping teams, drivers, and other support staff. Define responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure adherence to service standards. Prepare periodic MIS reports covering expenses, maintenance, vendor performance, inventory, and facility operations. Coordinate with HR, Finance, Purchase, IT, EHS, and Plant Operations to ensure effective cross-functional support. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA or a relevant qualification in Administration, Facility Management, or Operations will be an added advantage. 7-12 years of relevant experience in administration, preferably in a manufacturing, industrial, or corporate environment. Experience managing both corporate office and plant administration is strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of facility management, vendor management, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and administrative budgeting. Experience in handling multiple locations, administrative teams, and service providers. Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, documentation, and administrative systems. Good communication, negotiation, coordination, and team-management skills.

Key Skills: Administration Management,Petty Cash Management,Travel Arrangements,Government Liasoning,Facility Administration,Housekeeping Management,Facility Management,Cafeteria Management

 About the Role We are looking for an experienced Major Account Manager to drive enterprise sales of IT hardware, office automation equipment, security and surveillance systems, and other technology hardware products to corporate and enterprise customers. The ideal candidate should have a strong track record in direct B2B sales, major account management, new client acquisition, and building relationships with CXO-level stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities Drive direct enterprise sales of IT hardware, office automation products, and technology equipment. Sell products such as printers, copiers, scanners, multifunction devices (MFDs), laptops, desktops, servers, networking equipment, CCTV cameras, video surveillance systems, access control systems, and related hardware solutions. Explore opportunities across corporate accounts, large enterprises, government organizations, and other institutional customers, wherever relevant. Identify new business opportunities through account mapping, market research, and strategic account planning. Develop and maintain strong relationships with CXOs, IT Heads, Administration Heads, Purchase Managers, and other key decision-makers. Acquire new enterprise customers and expand business within existing accounts. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable hardware products and solutions. Prepare proposals, negotiate pricing, and manage rate contracts, commercial agreements, and tenders where applicable. Coordinate with pre-sales, technical, implementation, and service teams to ensure smooth project execution. Identify opportunities to replace competitors' products and increase account penetration. Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue objectives, and business growth goals. Maintain customer relationships to drive repeat business and long-term account growth. Required Skills & Competencies Strong experience in enterprise sales, key account management, and direct B2B selling. Good understanding of IT hardware, office automation, security surveillance, or other corporate technology products. Proven ability to handle large corporate accounts and high-value sales. Strong CXO networking, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Excellent communication, business acumen, and customer orientation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
 Preferred Industry Background Candidates from companies dealing in the following areas will be preferred: IT Hardware: Laptops, desktops, servers, networking equipment, and IT peripherals. Office Automation: Printers, copiers, scanners, multifunction devices, and document management equipment. Security & Surveillance: CCTV, IP cameras, video management systems, access control, and related security hardware. Audio-Visual Solutions: Projectors, video conferencing equipment, displays, and conference room hardware. Enterprise Technology & Telecom Hardware: Corporate networking, communication equipment, and related hardware solutions. title: Senior Engineer-Production and Testing
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineer Production & Testing with 15+ years of hands-on experience in the manufacturing and testing of power and distribution transformers. The ideal candidate will own day-to-day shop-floor production and the transformer test bay, ensuring output meets production schedules, quality standards, and customer/third-party test requirements. The role demands strong practical command of the full manufacturing sequence and of routine, type, and special testing, along with close coordination with the design, quality, planning, and stores functions. 
 Key Responsibilities Production Plan, execute, and supervise daily shop-floor production across core cutting, coil winding, core-coil assembly, drying (vacuum/VPI), tanking, and final assembly, in line with the production schedule and released drawings. Interpret General Arrangement (GA), core, winding, and tank/fabrication drawings, GTPs, and process sheets released by the design office, and translate them into accurate shop-floor execution. Achieve daily and monthly production targets through effective manpower deployment, shift planning, and line balancing. Monitor in-process quality at each manufacturing stage and ensure adherence to work instructions, process parameters, and applicable IS/IEC standards. Coordinate with design, quality, production planning, stores, and procurement to ensure material availability, smooth WIP flow, and timely resolution of shop-floor bottlenecks. Drive productivity improvement, cycle-time reduction, and optimal utilisation of raw materials (CRGO, copper/aluminium conductors, insulation, oil), minimising scrap and rework. Implement and sustain 5S, Kaizen, housekeeping, and shop-floor safety practices. 
 Key Responsibilities Testing Plan and conduct routine, type, and special tests as per IS 2026 / IEC 60076 — including turns ratio, winding resistance, insulation resistance, no-load and load losses, impedance, temperature rise, applied/induced overvoltage, and impulse tests, as applicable to the plant range. Conduct routine and acceptance tests in the presence of third-party inspection agencies and customer witnesses (CPRI / third-party) — a priority requirement of this role. Operate and supervise the test bay, ensuring correct test setups, instrument readiness, and full compliance with test-safety protocols. Maintain calibration status, test records, and traceability for all measuring and test instruments. title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Description Regional Sales Manager (South India Region) Position: Regional Sales Manager – South
 Location: [Bangalore / Chennai - as South Region Base]
 Department: Sales
 Reports To: Head – Sales /CSO
 Industry Preference: Industrial Sales (Machinery, Capital Equipment, Tools or similar) Role Overview 
 The Regional Sales Manager will lead and grow sales operations within the assigned region, focusing on Testing & Calibration Equipment for the Automotive, Electrical, Aerospace, EV, and Government R&D sectors. This role demands a strategic and results-oriented professional with strong leadership and technical sales expertise. The incumbent will drive regional sales strategies, manage key accounts, guide the sales team, and expand market share to achieve the company’s business growth objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute strategic sales plans tailored to the South Indian market to consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets and market share goals. Identify and convert new business opportunities by targeting OEMs, research and calibration labs, quality/test centres, and automotive component manufacturers. Manage, grow, and retain existing accounts by ensuring customers maximize value from both standard and custom products and services. Understand customer technical requirements related to test and measurement solutions; propose and facilitate technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept trials, and custom designs. Lead all sales stages end-to-end: prospecting, application-focused selling, quotation preparation, negotiation, and closing while protecting margins and ensuring timely delivery. Coordinate closely with internal teams including Engineering, Product Application, Calibration, and Service to align solutions with customer expectations and specifications. Monitor competitor activity, pricing strategies, market trends, regulatory changes, and industry standards, adapting sales approaches accordingly. Ensure timely collection of receivables, maintain healthy customer accounts, and manage regional sales budgets. Produce accurate sales forecasts, monthly/quarterly MIS reports, and business plans for senior management review. Represent Sushma Industries at regional trade shows, technical expos, and industry conferences. Recruit, train, and mentor a regional sales team as needed to scale operations and enhance sales performance. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of capital equipment / machine manufacturing / SPM industry. Deep knowledge of Test & Measurement, Calibration instrumentation, and capital equipment selling. Strong technical understanding of sensors, torque/force testing systems, data acquisition, calibration, etc. Excellent sales, negotiation, and relationship-building ability, especially with OEMs, calibration labs, automotive & quality-centric customers. Good understanding of standards/certifications (ISO / NABL etc.), calibration practices. Ability to translate technical features into business/ROI value for customers. Self-starter, target-oriented, ability to work independently across a large territory. Strong communication skills in English + preference for local languages (Tamil / Telugu / Kannada) for deep regional penetration. Leadership ability: mentoring, team coordination, possibly recruiting regional resources. Qualifications B.E / B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical / Mechatronics or related; higher technical qualification or MBA is a plus. 8-12 years of sales experience in industrial test & measurement, calibration, or capital equipment. At least 4-6 years covering South India essential. Experience selling sensors & gauges, torque/force/pressure test systems, or OEM instrumentation is highly desirable. Prior track record of meeting/exceeding sales targets, managing large accounts, negotiating technical & commercial terms. Strong network in automotive, R&D labs, calibration labs, manufacturing sectors in South India.

Key Skills: Instruments,Industrial,Regional,Machine building,Calibration,Measurement,SPM,Sensor

title: Lead Salesforce
description:
About the Role We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Salesforce Lead to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions . The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking. As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations. This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Delivery Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams. Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment. Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements. Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution. Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews. Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks. Solution Design & Development Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organizations Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities. Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities. Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs. Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including: Incident Management Service Request Management Change Management Problem Management Knowledge Management Employee Support Services CMDB Management IT Asset Management Service Catalog Management Integration & Enterprise Architecture Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns. Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems. Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency. Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices. Team Leadership & Mentoring Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support. Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team. Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges. AI & Platform Innovation Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations. Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences. Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making. Required Qualifications Must Have 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role. Strong hands-on expertise across: Service Cloud Sales Cloud Experience Cloud Salesforce Platform Deep technical expertise in: Apex Lightning Web Components (LWC) Salesforce Flows SOQL/SOSL Platform Events Integration Patterns REST/SOAP APIs Salesforce Security Model Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs. Experience leading and mentoring development teams. Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects. Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance. Strong understanding of: Data Architecture Security & Sharing Models DevOps & CI/CD Release Management Application Lifecycle Management Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments. Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions. Experience with: CMDB IT Asset Management (ITAM) Service Catalog Enterprise Operations Management Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management. Experience working in global delivery models. Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications. Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification. Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications. Added Advantage Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce. Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences. Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts. Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud. Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives. Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks. What We Are Looking For We are seeking professionals who: Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors. Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset. Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy. Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges. Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations. Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation. Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities. Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Why Join Us Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation. Influence platform architecture and engineering direction. Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team. Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders. Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways. Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued. Join Us If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce . This role offers the opportunity to combine technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.

title: Security Engineer - SIEM Engineer
description:
Job Title: Security Engineer - SIEM Engineer 
 Location: Kochi, India (Onsite) 
 Permanent - Full Time 
 About Us 
 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the worlds largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa. 
 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience. 
 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology. 
 Build Your Career with Cyncly in Kochi 
 Kochi is Cyncly s newest hub, opening doors to exciting career opportunities across diverse functions. Here, you ll collaborate with global experts, engage in innovative projects, and grow in a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and continuous learning. With access to top mentors, excellent learning resources, and a flexible and autonomous working environment, you ll have everything you need to thrive. 
 About the Role 
 As a Security Engineer specializing in Vulnerability Management, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Cyncly s digital assets. You will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing vulnerabilities across our global infrastructure. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure that vulnerabilities are remediated in a timely and effective manner, and that our security posture remains robust against emerging threats. This role offers the opportunity to drive continuous improvement in vulnerability management processes and directly impact the resilience of our digital environment. 
 Key Position Responsibilities Include: Lead the design, engineering, and ongoing optimization of the SIEM platform across global environments. Build and maintain log ingestion pipelines, parsers, connectors, and enrichment logic for both cloud and on-premises systems. Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, and analytics aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence. Partner with the Security Operations Center to enhance alert fidelity, reduce noise, and improve mean time to detect (MTTD). Drive SIEM data quality initiatives, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and visibility across critical systems. Onboard new log sources, ensuring proper parsing, normalization, categorization, and use-case mapping. Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and performance improvements within the SIEM platform. Build dashboards, visualizations, and reporting models for executives, SOC analysts, and stakeholders. Collaborate with cloud, DevOps, and IT teams to integrate SIEM monitoring into new products, services, and infrastructure. Stay current with threat landscape changes and ensure detections evolve accordingly. Support incident response activities with advanced investigation capabilities and forensic data enrichment. Contribute to documentation, playbooks, and engineering runbooks. Mentor analysts as the SIEM subject matter expert. 
 Required Experience and Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in security engineering, SIEM engineering, SOC operations, or detection engineering roles. Deep hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, QRadar, or similar). Strong understanding of log ingestion, parsing, normalization, and schema design. Proven experience building custom detections, analytics rules, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Solid understanding of cloud log sources (Azure, AWS, GCP) and API-based integrations. Proficiency with KQL, SPL, SQL, or other query languages used for detection and analytics. Experience with automation/orchestration tooling (SOAR) is a strong plus. Familiarity with security frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally in a global environment. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving landscape. 
 Required Skills and Competencies: SIEM engineering (log pipelines, connectors, ingestion tuning). Detection engineering and analytics rule development. KQL, SPL, or equivalent query language expertise. Deep understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and threat-driven detection. Ability to evaluate and onboard new log sources. Incident response support and investigation experience. Dashboarding and data visualization. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Ability to collaborate with global teams. Continuous learning mindset and passion for modern security operations. 
 Working for Us 
 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect. Here, you ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth. We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together. If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: SRE Tools Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 DevOps Engineer Azure, Automation, Splunk & Dynatrace
 Role Overview 
We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer with strong experience in CI/CD, Azure infrastructure, automation, and containerized environments, complemented by administrative knowledge of Splunk and Dynatrace.
The role will focus on automating deployments, infrastructure, and observability setupensuring applications and services can be quickly onboarded, validated, and ready for production monitoring.
 Key Responsibilities 
1. CI/CD & Release Automation
Design and maintain pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. Automate builds, testing, deployments, and post-deployment validation, incorporating approval controls, rollback mechanisms, and secure release practices.
2. Azure Infrastructure & Infrastructure as Code
Provision and manage Azure services, including AKS, App Services, Azure Functions, networking, and storage. Use Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent tools to automate provisioning, standardize configurations, and improve scalability and cost efficiency.
3. Containerization & Kubernetes
Build and maintain Docker images and Kubernetes deployment configurations. Manage AKS workloads, scaling, resource allocation, and health checks; troubleshoot container, connectivity, and deployment issues.
4. Automation & Security
Develop reusable scripts using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to reduce manual effort across infrastructure, deployments, and operational workflows. Automate configuration management and integrate security scanning, secrets management, and access controls into delivery processes.
5. Splunk & Dynatrace Administration, Automation & Production Readiness
Automate platform setup, agent/forwarder deployment, configuration, and application onboarding to accelerate production-monitoring readiness. Support access management, platform health, and troubleshooting. Integrate reusable automation and readiness checks into CI/CD pipelines to validate log ingestion, telemetry collection, and monitoring coverage before go-live.
6. SRE & Production Reliability
Apply SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and post-incident reviews. Partner with SRE L2/L3 teams to resolve production issues, reduce MTTR, and automate recurring operational and recovery activities.
7. Collaboration & Enablement 
Provide reusable automation templates, operational runbooks, and engineering standards. Enable self-service provisioning and monitoring onboarding, integrate workflows with ServiceNow or Jira, and guide teams on deployment and operational readiness. 
 Required Qualifications 
5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience, including CI/CD ownership, infrastructure automation, and production troubleshooting.
Strong experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools, along with Git-based workflows.
Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Linux.
Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including API-based automation and tool integration.
Working administrative knowledge of both Splunk and Dynatrace, including access management, forwarder/agent configuration, data onboarding, platform health, and troubleshooting.
Ability to automate monitoring setup, streamline application onboarding, and validate production-monitoring readiness.
Understanding of SRE fundamentals, with strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience supporting retail/e-commerce platforms, microservices, and distributed systems. Familiarity with Helm, GitOps/Argo CD, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Splunk, or Dynatrace are good to have, but not mandatory.
Success Measures
Reduced time to onboard applications into production monitoring; increased automation and self-service adoption; validated monitoring coverage before go-live; fewer manual configuration errors; and improved deployment reliability and incident resolution time.

Job Summary Talent Acquisition Lead India | Global Talent Acquisition Shift Timing - IST 5 PM - 2 AM Overview of Position The Talent Acquisition Lead is responsible for implementing talent acquisition processes across Diversified s global operations, including the US, Canada, EMEA, Australia and India. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates. The Talent Acquisition Lead partners with global (US-based) Talent Acquisition leadership, regional HR teams, and hiring leaders to translate agreed processes into practical workflows, support adoption, and contribute ideas for improvement. Success requires demonstrated experience implementing comparable recruitment processes across regions, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to use ATS and candidate data to improve hiring efficiency and service quality. Key Accountabilities Implement talent acquisition processes globally, adapting execution to regional requirements in partnership with local HR while maintaining consistent standards. Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders. Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding. Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs. Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones. Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely. Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment. Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through. Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected. Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified s values and employer brand. Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records. Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance. Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements. Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR. Qualifications Education Education: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. Experience 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team. Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes. Team Leadership: Proven experience leading, guiding, and coaching specialists responsible for sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer preparation or coordination. English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes. Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred. Skills and Competencies Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change. Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred. Key Success Metrics Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions. Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities. Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records. Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets. Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination. Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

title: Deputy Manager - HR Operations
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 To ensure seamless HR operations across multiple EPC projects by managing manpower data, payroll inputs, HR compliance documentation, workforce analytics, mobilization and demobilization records, and audit-ready employee databases. The incumbent will support business leadership through accurate manpower intelligence, workforce cost analysis, and operational HR excellence. 
 1. Workforce Management & Manpower Analytics Maintain centralized manpower database for all active and upcoming projects. Track project-wise headcount, deployment, mobilization, demobilization, transfers, and manpower productivity. Prepare and publish Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Management MIS reports. Analyse manpower trends, attrition, vacancies, productivity ratios, and utilization levels. Support SBG leadership with workforce planning and manpower optimization analytics. Generate reports on direct, indirect, staff, workmen, subcontractor, and outsourced manpower. Track manpower budgets versus actual deployment. 2. Project Mobilization & Demobilization Operations Coordinate employee mobilization for new projects in line with approved manpower plans. Monitor joining schedules, deployment status, and project movement orders. Maintain demobilization trackers and manpower release plans. Track manpower cost savings achieved through demobilization initiatives. Ensure timely documentation and approval workflows for employee movements. 3. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management Manage employee onboarding, documentation, transfers, confirmations, promotions, and separations. Ensure timely updating of HRMS and employee master data. Maintain employee records and digital documentation for all project locations. Coordinate with Site HR teams for workforce data accuracy and standardization. 4. Payroll Input Management Consolidate payroll inputs from all project sites. Validate attendance, leave records, overtime, site allowances, incentive payouts, and deductions. Coordinate with payroll team for accurate salary processing. Reconcile payroll variances and address discrepancies. Ensure payroll inputs are submitted within established timelines. 5. Audit-Ready HR Documentation Maintain all employee records in audit-ready condition. Ensure completeness and accuracy of statutory, contractual, and HR documents. Support Internal Audit, ISO Audit, Client Audit, Labour Audit, and Compliance Reviews. Maintain document repositories with version control and retrieval mechanisms. Monitor closure of audit observations and compliance gaps.

title: Hiring Purchase Manager- International Procurement Purchase For Mumbai
description:
CANDIDATES WHO ARE AVAILABLE FOR WALK-IN INTERVIEWS CAN ONLY APPLY. 
 Job Title: Purchase Manager - Procurement Experience: 10+ Years Salary: 10 to 12 LPA Location: Mumbai - Andheri West Qualification: Bachelors degree in any stream; MBA/PG Diploma in Supply Chain or International Business preferred. Supply Chain/Purchase Management certification is an advantage. Working Day: 6 Days Office Timing: 8.00 AM To 5.00 PM 
 CANDIDATE WHO CAN JOIN IMMEDIATE OR 15 DAYS 
 Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Procurement Manager with strong expertise in international procurement, global sourcing, supplier management and import-export operations. The candidate should have substantial experience in an international import-export organisation, particularly in business dealings with China, Europe and the Far East. Experience in FMCG, FMCD, food, staple commodities, retail and international trading will be preferred. The ideal candidate should be proficient in supplier negotiations, procurement operations, EXIM documentation, international logistics, cost optimization and ERP-based purchase management. 
 Mandatory Requirements: 10+ years of experience in a similar procurement/purchase role within an international import-export organisation or function. Significant business dealings with suppliers and customers in China, Europe and the Far East. Experience in international trading, particularly across China, Europe, the Far East and Africa. Experience handling a minimum of 150-200 container loads per month and 4,000-5,000 SKUs or more . Experience handling 500+ containers per month for African markets will be preferred. Experience managing at least 10 suppliers and customers across transactions. Hands-on experience using ERP software for purchase management; Axpert is preferred . Willingness to travel internationally for vendor visits and trade fairs. Strong understanding of international trade, sourcing, buying and import-export processes. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management Identify, evaluate and onboard international suppliers across China, Europe, Far East, Africa and other markets. Source FMCG, FMCD, food products, rice, confectionery, biscuits, kitchenware, electronics and other commodities. Build long-term supplier relationships, negotiate contracts and pricing, and ensure product quality, timely delivery and cost efficiency. 2. Procurement Operations Manage the complete procurement cycle, including RFQs, purchase orders, sampling, quality checks, Pro Forma Invoices and logistics coordination. Ensure accuracy of purchase orders, pricing, specifications, quantities and delivery schedules. Track orders, shipments and payments, manage multiple suppliers and customers, and use ERP software, preferably Axpert. 3. International Trade & EXIM Coordination Coordinate with international suppliers, customers and logistics partners for smooth import-export operations. Manage import-export documentation, product labelling, customs clearance, export registration and trade compliance. Ensure compliance with international trade practices, Incoterms and shipment requirements. Travel internationally for supplier visits, business meetings and trade fairs as required. 4. New Product Development & Private Label Sourcing Identify new products and suppliers based on market trends and customer requirements. Evaluate samples, compare products and suppliers, and support private-label/white-label sourcing and new product development. 5. Cost Optimization & Negotiation Negotiate supplier pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs), Incoterms and commercial terms. Conduct landed-cost analysis, identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize procurement costs while maintaining quality and profitability. 6. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Sales, Finance, Logistics, Operations and Quality teams to ensure smooth procurement and supply chain execution. Provide updates on purchase orders, shipment status, delays and forecasts, and resolve supplier/customer-related operational issues. 7. Documentation, Audit & Compliance Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier documentation and communication trails. Ensure all procurement and international trade documents are audit-ready and comply with company policies and applicable trade regulations. 

 Interested Candidate Can Call Or WhatsApp Resume on - Ruchi - 9082070785 Or Mail On - tl.west@million-minds.com

description:
About Tetr College of Business Five years ago, we started Masters Union; our vision: to redefine the landscape of business education. We posed a simple question: If aspiring doctors learn from seasoned physicians and budding lawyers learn from legal experts, why shouldn't future business leaders learn directly from industry experts?
After all, can a lecture on Accounting 101 truly compare to the hands-on experience of analyzing real PnL statements?
Today, Masters' Union has an unparalleled curriculum with faculty comprising Industry Leaders and practitioners unlike any other in the country. Our academic council includes CXOs, MDs, Eminent Public Leaders, and even Members of Parliament. In just four years of operations, our flagship PGP in Technology and Business Management has achieved remarkable success, surpassing the placement records of esteemed institutions like IIM Ahmedabad and ISB.
Masters Union is now ranked among the top 2 B-schools in the country based on placement records. 
With our growing global recognition, we realized that the hands-on experience of building real businesses, which proved to be highly effective for students in India, could offer immense value to aspiring entrepreneurs worldwide. 
Thus, the idea of Tetr was born.
 Picture this: a business program that isn't just about textbooks and lecturesit's an adventure that spans 7 different countries, with each semester bringing a new destination and a wealth of experience. 
 Imagine studying at iconic institutions like INSEAD, NUS, SDA Bocconi, and IIT and learning from some of the brightest minds in the business world like Dr. Edward Rogers (Former Chief Knowledge Officer, NASA), Mr. Faverie Stephane (Executive Group President, Estee Lauder) and Mr. Saud Swar (CBO, American Express, MENA).
