description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As DAML, you will be building the marketing strategy for the assigned brands and overall disease area; and be responsible for ensuring the marketing strategy gets delivered with confidence and conviction in working closely with the cluster marketing and broader teams. You will connect with the CEETRIS/ global teams to pull brand solutions from the network and help develop via work packages where gaps exist. You will be a member of the Cross Functional Pan India Disease Squad; and report into the Disease Area squad Lead. 
 The Opportunity You will be Co-creating portfolio strategy, plans and objectives leveraging outside in perspective Build the integrated DA and Brand Plan along with the DA Squad Lead, the cross functio nal Pan India DA team, and importantly the PPOCs across India. It will be critically important the strategy is built on the insights gained from the PJPs and HSPs and the cluster teams. They are closest to our customers and their insights need to lead the strategy development. You will be building strong relationships with the identified key stakeholders from Key Doctors, Accounts or Government stakeholders to build Roche equity and gain customer insights - to incorporate into our work. You will ensure compliance of the marketing strategy with Roche and Local guidelines for all Roche Initiatives and develop Patient Persona based solutions. You will liaison with Global & regional team for brand related campaigns, cross Pollination of Best Practices and share insights from cluster specific data on patients, diseases, patient journey etc and design solutions to increase patient impact Design of awareness campaigns solving for patient journey challenges & calculate ROIs and support customization of pricing. In this context, the role provides commercial insights to inform Access & Medical functions, but does not own decision-making for pricing, commercial contracting, reimbursement, etc. Marketing and field insights will be generated using methodologies that comply with data privacy laws, competition laws, and ethical standards. You will gather insights and prepare effective pre-launch / launch strategies for new assets in the respective disease areas ensuring that the latest innovations reach patients in need 
 Who you are We are seeking a highly collaborative, process-oriented Marketing Postgraduate with 5+ years of specialized experience within the Oncology therapeutic area (specifically lung or liver cancer). This individual will possess a powerful combination of commercial acumen, strong alliance management capabilities, and a proven track record of high-impact marketing execution within the complex Indian healthcare ecosystem. Key Competencies & Qualifications Oncology Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Indian healthcare ecosystem , emerging market landscapes, and specific clinical nuances of lung/liver oncology. Commercial & Strategic Marketing: Strong mastery of marketing fundamentals, a data-driven insight generation mindset, and a history of flawless campaign execution. Alliance Management & Collaboration: Exceptional networking and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage complex external alliances and drive cross-functional teamwork. Operational Rigor & Project Management: A highly structured, process-oriented approach backed by strong project management skills, fluency in modern productivity tools, and strict compliance with organizational SOPs and external regulations. Problem-Solving & Communication: An articulate communicator adept at converting customer insights into actionable commercial strategies to solve complex market challenges. 
 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100 000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. 
Let s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer. "

description:
Job DESCRIPTION Job Title: Manager - Digital Fundraising Grade: F Department: Resource Mobilization Reporting to: Director - RM Location: National Support Office (NSO), New Delhi Contract duration: 5 years (extendable) About Bal Raksha Bharat Bal Raksha Bharat (also known as Save the Children) is Indias leading independent child rights organisation. It is a member of Save the Children movement that operates globally with the mission to inspire breakthroughs in the way the world treats children and achieve immediate and lasting changes in their lives. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: - No child dies from preventable causes before their fifth birthday - All children learn from a quality basic education - Violence against children is no longer tolerated We implement programmes in the remotest corners of India and urban areas in the areas of Health & Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Livelihood & Economic Wellbeing in order to facilitate quality education, healthcare and protection from harm and abuse and life-saving aid during emergencies to children. Role Purpose : Digital lead is in charge of planning and managing marketing campaigns that promote organisations work, bring in donations and improve its presence and brand value. Their duties include planning campaigns, analysing metrics, and identifying trends. Roles & Responsibilities Design, execution and overseeing of a long term competent and innovating national digital engagement and fundraising strategy, as well as an annual action plan for the online fundraising activities, ensuring that they are aligned with Save the Children India objectives and programmes. Design, execution and overseeing of the digital fundraising emergency plan. Experience to lead, design, implement and monitor the digital campaign with all digital social and marketing channel Overseeing of the web fundraising content and functionalities as well as the implementation of digital marketing and fundraising campaign initiatives. Design and implement online acquisition campaign using paid search and online advertising. Manage relationships with external vendors and agencies. Design and implement other digital fundraising campaigns like crowdfunding / community fundraising, mobile apps, etc. Assist the Donor Development department to design, implement and optimize the digital donor life cycle. Editing and setting up email campaigns when needed. Collaborate with other fundraising departments to ensure proper digital support and web content to maximize overall fundraising success. Network with Save the Children International to share ideas and leverage best practice from other offices. Other duties as requested by the Head of Fundraising. BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice) Accountability - Holds self and others accountable for delivering high-quality, timely and compliant services aligned with organisational goals. - Demonstrates ownership and responsibility for procurement decisions, resources and commitments with integrity. Ambition - Sets ambitious goals for efficiency, value for money, service quality and operational excellence. - Seeks opportunities to simplify, innovate and build a high-performing procurement and facilities function. Collaboration - Builds strong relationships across functions, state teams and external stakeholders. - Encourages mutual respect, transparency, knowledge sharing and customer-focused service. Creativity - Brings innovative and practical solutions to sourcing, facilities, technology and cost optimisation challenges. - Champions new approaches that improve efficiency, sustainability and user experience. Integrity - Upholds the highest ethical standards, transparency and fairness in procurement and vendor dealings. - Promotes responsible stewardship of organisational resources and puts childrens best interests at the centre of decisions. QUALIFICATIONS MBA/ PGDBM from a reputed Institute / Masters in English or Journalism or Mass Communications EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Minimum 7 years of experience in digital fundraising or e-commerce designing including management of digital operations for at least 3 years. Relevant experience developing digital engagement and awareness campaigns with a proven record of accomplishments. Experience to manage digital fundraising agencies. Skills & Knowledge Deep knowledge of search and display Campaigns, paid social media advertising, digital marketing and lead generation and conversion programs. Working knowledge of web development and web analytics. Proven ability to do result driven data analysis. Positive and learned professional with team management experience and exceptional ability to organize and manage multiple priorities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, Solid knowledge of MS office applications. Self-motivated, mentally strong leader with an ability to inspire team members and keep the team together. Equal Opportunities Bal Raksha Bharat aims to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applications irrespective of age, race, colour, gender, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or creed. Women candidates are encouraged to apply. Child Safeguarding We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse. CHILD SAFEGUARDING (Strike out whichever is not applicable) Level 1: The role holder will not have contact with children and/or young people, or access to personal data about children or young people, as part of their work; therefore, a police check will not be mandatory unless the content or location of the role changes, in which case the Child Safeguarding level will be reviewed. Level 2: Either the role holder will have access to personal data about children and/or young people as part of their work; or they will be working in a regulated position (Finance, Monitoring & Evaluation, Legal etc.); therefore, a police check will be required. Level 3: The role holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work in programs; or are visiting programs; therefore a police check will be required. Recommended for this role: Level 2, subject to BRBs role-based safeguarding assessment. Safeguarding our Staff The post holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the BRB s anti-harassment policy and all applicable safeguarding, health, safety, security and ethical standards.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
We are hiring a Performance Marketing Specialist to plan, run and scale our paid acquisition across Meta and Google. You will own budget allocation, campaign structure, creative testing and channel efficiency for every programme vertical. The role is accountable for how much we spend, where it goes, and what it returns in qualified leads and admissions. 
 Why this role Paid media is measured by the qualified leads and admissions it returns, not by spend or clicks alone. Cost per lead is not the finish line; paid performance is judged on what happens beyond the click. Creative and budget decisions should be driven by performance data rather than opinion. Spend that is not returning admissions should be paused or rebuilt, not left to run. You will work closely with the Creative, Funnel and CRM teams to improve landing page performance, lead quality and paid channel efficiency. 
 What you will do You will own paid acquisition across Meta and Google, from budget planning and campaign build to optimisation and reporting. Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta and Google Ads for each programme vertical. Own monthly budget allocation across channels, campaigns and programmes, and manage pacing against plan. Build and maintain campaign architecture, naming conventions, audiences, placements and bid strategies. Run a continuous creative testing pipeline and brief the creative team based on performance data rather than opinion. Manage search keyword strategy, run search-term audits and maintain negative keyword lists. Monitor delivery daily and act on rising costs, frequency and creative fatigue before they compound. Maintain accurate conversion tracking and attribution across platforms and landing pages. Analyse performance by programme, geography, audience and creative, and reallocate budget to what converts. Pause or rebuild campaigns that are not returning admissions and document the reasons. Work with the Funnel and CRM team on landing page performance and lead quality feedback loops. Report weekly on spend, cost per lead, cost per admission and channel-level efficiency. 
 What you will deliver Key Result Areas (KRAs) Paid media planning and budget management Campaign performance and cost efficiency Creative testing and audience development Tracking, attribution and reporting accuracy Programme-level admissions growth through paid channels 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Cost per lead and cost per admission against target Monthly spend pacing against plan, including underspend and overspend variance Return on ad spend, measured against the agreed ticket value CTR, CPC and CPM trends by channel, quarter on quarter Lead-to-admission conversion rate of paid leads Number of creatives tested per month and share of spend behind winning creatives Share of spend on campaigns with zero attributed admissions, to be minimised Turnaround time from identifying an underperforming campaign to acting on it 
 Who we are looking for Must have Bachelor's degree with 24 years of hands-on experience managing paid media budgets across Meta and Google Ads. Demonstrable ownership of a monthly media budget. Strong grasp of campaign structure, audience building, bid strategies and search-term management. Practical tracking knowledge, including UTM discipline, pixel and conversion event setup, and tag management. Comfortable working in spreadsheets and able to build performance reports independently. Ability to read a funnel beyond the click, with the understanding that cost per lead is not the finish line. Target-driven, with the discipline to pause spend that is not working.

title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early. In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend. We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds. Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules. 

 Responsibilities 
 As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic Testing: Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan. So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today" and see what the AI says. Does the AI say yesDoes it calculate the early payment fee correctlyWhat if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spellingWhat if you type in a mix of Hindi and EnglishWhat if you pretend to be very angryDoes the AI still understand and stay politeYou will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain): The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to. If a customer types, "What is my balance", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters. As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI." You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. Visualisations: Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen. Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations. Let\'s say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly. Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn\'t make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product Switching: Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand." At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing. We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later. Conversation Flows: A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows. You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. 
Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help" -> Arrow points to Box 2. 
Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. 
Box 3: The system checks if the customer\'s phone number is verified. 
If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4. 
If No -> Arrow points to Box 5. 
Box 4: Show the statement on the screen. 
Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP). You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone What if the internet crashes You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write

title: Accounts Payable Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 The primary responsibility of the Accounts Payable role is to manage and process payments to vendors, ensuring timely and accurate disbursement of funds. This includes verifying invoices against purchase orders, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and ensuring timely payment releases. Additionally, the role also manages the disbursement of employee expenses. 
 Principal Accountabilities 
 Financial Reporting & Audit Support - Contribute to cash flow forecasting and budgeting processes by analyzing trends in accounts payable data and providing valuable insights to the Regional Head. Provide variance analysis for project expenses and cash flows for review to the Regional Head and project team. Perform periodic vendor reconciliations & Prepare Vendor aging and forward the same for payment to the Treasury Team. Clear open entries, reconcile vendor ledgers, and ensure timely system closing and monthly MIS reporting. Seek inputs from the regional Accounts head and submit accurate input (expenditure MIS) for RERA compliances. Support internal and statutory audits by furnishing required details. Payable Management - Validate Invoices with corresponding purchase orders (POs), thoroughly resolving any discrepancies to maintain accuracy and consistency in financial accounting entry and documentation. Validate vendor compliance adherence to regulations and verify their compliance with recovery obligations if any. Ensure accurate booking of vendor invoices and expedite the release of payments upon thorough verification, maintaining strict adherence to procedural accuracy and timeliness. Ensure timely clearance of invoices booking and payment receipts to prevent any backlog. Identify and mitigate risks related to accounts payable operations, including fraud, duplicate payments, and late fees. Digitization & Data Assurance - Propose automation interventions for areas under payment management. Implement finalized automation intervention in collaboration with various stakeholders. Ensure effective usage of the automation interventions.

 Experience: Minimum 10 years

 About the Role Our Germany-based office is looking for an experienced, hands-on professional to manage the technical planning, fabrication and construction of exhibition stands for trade fairs (Messe) in Germany and across Europe. The primary responsibility is to turn existing designs and concepts into high-quality, practical and cost-effective exhibition stands. The candidate will coordinate with designers, workshops, suppliers and European installation teams to ensure that stands are manufactured, transported, assembled and dismantled successfully.

Supervise on-site stand assembly and dismantling in Germany and other European countries when required. 
 Requirements Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in exhibition stand construction, fabrication or exhibition project execution. Strong practical knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, CNC machinery and technical drawings. Experience converting designs into finished, ready-to-install exhibition stands. Ability to independently manage projects from technical planning through fabrication to final installation. Good English communication, organisational and cost-management skills. Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe. 
 Experience working with German or European trade fairs and contractors is a strong advantage. Knowledge of AutoCAD, SketchUp and other technical drawing tools is preferred. 
 How to Apply Please submit your CV, photographs or a portfolio of completed exhibition stands, details of at least three projects personally managed, current salary, expected salary and notice period.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator
description:
Job Description Accounts Payable - Sr. Coordinator Department: Finance / Accounting - Accounts Payable Reports To: Accounts Payable Manager / Supervisor Job Level: Staff (Individual Contributor) Location: Greater Bangalore Area / hybrid remote Job Summary The Accounts Payable Sr. Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of the organizations payables, including invoice review, PO matching, and payment processing, along with vendor account reconciliation and reporting. This role has a substantial understanding of accounts payable practices and applies that knowledge and skill set to complete a wide range of AP and general accounting tasks. Work assignments are moderately difficult and require the incumbent to use judgment to resolve discrepancies, research issues, and recommend process improvements. The AP Staff Accountant works closely with the AP team and will escalate non-routine or higher-risk issues to the Senior AP Manager. Key Responsibilities Process a full range of accounts payable transactions, including three-way matching of purchase orders, receipts, and invoices, ensuring accurate general ledger coding and appropriate approvals. Review, research, and resolve moderately complex invoice discrepancies, coding errors, and vendor disputes, exercising judgment in determining root cause and appropriate resolution. Reconcile vendor statements and AP subledger to the general ledger; investigate and resolve variances. Maintain vendor master data, including W-9 collection, TIN verification, and setup/updates in the ERP system. Support month-end close activities, including AP aging analysis and preparation of supporting schedules. Assist with 1099 reporting and other year-end tax filing support related to vendor payments. Respond to internal and vendor inquiries regarding invoice and payment status in a timely, professional manner. Identify opportunities to improve AP workflows and controls, and recommend process or system enhancements to the Senior AP Manager. Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls (e.g., SOX where applicable), and relevant accounting standards. Support special projects, system implementations, or process transitions as assigned. Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications Education Associates or Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Experience Minimum of 2-3 years of related accounts payable or general accounting experience. Experience working within an ERP or accounting system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics) required. Prior experience in a mid-size or larger organization, or shared services environment, is a plus. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Substantial working knowledge of accounts payable processes, general accounting principles, and internal controls. Demonstrated ability to apply judgment in resolving moderately complex issues and making recommendations without extensive oversight. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in high-volume transaction processing. Proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas); comfortable working with large data sets. Strong English written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with vendors and internal stakeholders across departments. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-based accounting function. Working Conditions remote/hybrid/on-site - Bangalore Office Occasional extended hours may be required during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close. Primarily sedentary work involving extended computer use.

description:
Indus Parking Services (IPS) is an emerging parking enforcement company based in the heart of Gurugram, India. description:
About Intensiv-Filter Himenviro Intensiv-Filter Himenviro (IFH) is a clean-air technology company with more than 100 years of filtration expertise, dating back to 1922. We design, manufacture, install and service industrial air pollution control equipment, including bag filters, reverse air baghouses, electrostatic precipitators and hybrid filters, for cement, steel, power, chemical, food and other process industries, with teams in India and Germany and customers worldwide. 
 About the role You will handle day-to-day procurement for our manufacturing and project requirements: sourcing, comparing quotations, placing orders and following up with vendors until the material arrives. A good knowledge of sheet-metal components is important. The role involves regular visits to vendors in the Delhi NCR area. 
 Key responsibilities Handle purchase activities for project, engineering and plant requirements on new and ongoing projects. Float purchase enquiries to vendors, collect quotations and prepare comparative statements with price and cost analysis. Negotiate with vendors and place purchase orders after approval. Prepare and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately, with correct specifications, quantities and delivery dates. Follow up with vendors against delivery dates and expedite where material is at risk of delay. Ensure uninterrupted supply of the right material, in the right quality and quantity, at the right time. Review vendor terms and agreements to secure good price and quality. Identify and develop new vendors for sheet-metal components and other regular requirements. Coordinate with project, stores, quality and accounts teams on delivery, quality and payment issues. Verify vendor invoices against orders and receipts, and forward them for payment. 
 What success looks like Material reaches the plant when production needs it. Orders are placed on properly compared quotations at competitive prices. Purchase orders are accurate and rarely need correction. Vendors are followed up before a delay becomes a shortage. 
 What you bring Essential Diploma, B.E. / B.Tech or Graduate degree. 6-11 years of experience in purchase / procurement in manufacturing or sheet-metal industries. Good knowledge of sheet-metal components and items. Ability to compare quotations, negotiate and follow up persistently with vendors. Working knowledge of MS Excel and accurate documentation. Ability to travel locally for frequent vendor visits. 
 Preferred Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering. Experience with ERP-based purchasing. Existing knowledge of sheet-metal and fabrication vendors in Delhi NCR. Ability to read basic drawings and bills of material. 
 Behavioural requirements Persistence Follows up with vendors until the material actually arrives. 
 Integrity Deals with vendors fairly and transparently. 
 Accuracy Gets specifications, quantities and dates right the first time. 
 Responsiveness Keeps production and projects informed of what is coming and when. 
 Why join IFH A solid grounding in procurement for engineered, project-based manufacturing. Exposure to a wide range of materials, from sheet metal to bought-out equipment. Daily interaction with production, projects and vendors.

Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.   Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 
Job Profile Summary The Third Party Risk Senior Associate supports the day-to-day operations of the Third-Party Risk Management pillar within Consulting Quality & Risk Management. Based in Noida, this position will provide third-party risk management (TPRM) expertise to maintain and evolve Crowe Consulting’s TPRM program. The position will be responsible for supporting Consulting’s daily TPRM queue, operations, reporting, and process improvement while working on a team under the direction of the Consulting TPRM program leader. 
Key Responsibilities Provide support to Crowe Consulting partners and other leaders regarding third-party matters, including, but not limited to, risk assessments, Request for Proposal (RFP) support, and findings remediation. Proactively monitor TPRM requests and identify stalled, slow-moving, or stopped matters for resolution or escalation. Monitor the Q&RM mailbox and administer the day-to-day workflow, including the review, execution, triage, follow-up, and finalization of inquiries and requests. Partner with internal stakeholders—including Information Security, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Risk Management, and business unit leaders—to ensure alignment on responses and supporting documentation. Assist in the preparation of TPRM-related reports, ensuring accurate data capture and up-to-date documentation. Maintain clear handoffs and documentation to support seamless coordination with U.S.-based team members. Help identify and implement improvements to third-party risk management processes, working with TPRM leadership to streamline workflows and reduce inefficiencies. Update policies and procedures and educate the Consulting team on key TPRM risk issues. Maintain insight into trends and changes in the TPRM landscape through industry insights, partnerships, and ongoing development.  Support firmwide risk management changes, including, but not limited to, technology transformation, process changes, and training and education.  Provide value-added recommendations and share best practices with the Consulting team. Support the Enterprise Risk Management program and additional risk domains, as required. 
Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree. Experience: Senior Associate: 3+ years of relevant experience, with a demonstrated ability to manage TPRM activities independently. Demonstrated problem-solving skills to identify quality, risk, and compliance issues and develop processes to prevent or detect future issues. Demonstrated professionalism and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and quality. Team-oriented, with experience working with diverse teams. Ability to leverage available resources and contribute through others. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, time zones, and levels of seniority. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ServiceNow, and AI productivity tools. Willingness to participate in both routine Quality & Risk Management (Q&RM) tasks and strategic cross functional projects. US Collaboration: willingness to work 4–5 hours of daily live overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT) teams for standups, handovers, and real-time collaboration to start. Candidate must have reliable means of commuting to and from local office. 
Preferred Qualifications Experience working in the professional services or financial services industry. General knowledge of banking compliance. Experience working with commercially available TPRM and/or GRC solutions. Relevant professional certifications preferred. Experience in project management. Experience working in a global capability center or similar distributed operating model supporting U.S.-based stakeholders. 
Work Environment This role sits within a growing, fast-paced Third-Party Risk Management function supporting a high volume of consulting engagements. Priorities can shift quickly, and the Senior Associate should be comfortable balancing routine, standardized work with time-sensitive requests. The role is based in Noida, India, and works extended hours to provide coverage aligned with U.S. business-day overlap. US collaboration is required with shift flexibility possible upon demonstration of functional proficiency.   We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship.  Reporting To: Board of Directors / Chairman / Promoters 1. Position Overview He will be responsible for the overall strategic, commercial, operational, technical and financial performance of the organisation, with full accountability for Profit & Loss (P&L), business growth, sales, business development, manufacturing, project execution, engineering, quality, EHS and ISO compliance . The role requires a dynamic, commercially astute and technically sound business leader with proven experience in managing large-scale industrial businesses, driving profitable growth, strengthening market presence, improving operational efficiency and building a high-performance organisation. He will work closely with the Board of Directors and Promoters to formulate and execute business strategies, maximise shareholder value, develop new markets, enhance customer relationships and ensure sustainable business growth. 2. Key Roles and Responsibilities A. Business Strategy & P&L Management Develop and execute the organisation's short-term and long-term business strategies in alignment with the vision of the Board and Promoters. Assume end-to-end responsibility for P&L, revenue growth, EBITDA, profitability, cash flow, working capital and return on investment. Prepare annual business plans, budgets, forecasts and strategic growth roadmaps. Identify opportunities for business expansion, diversification, new product development and geographical market penetration. Monitor financial and operational performance against agreed business targets and take corrective actions. Optimise operating costs, improve margins and ensure efficient utilisation of financial and physical resources. B. Sales, Marketing & Business Development Lead sales, marketing, key account management and business development functions to achieve revenue and order-booking targets. Develop new business opportunities across mining, mineral processing, cement, steel, power, infrastructure and other relevant industrial sectors. Build strong relationships with major customers, EPC contractors, consultants, OEMs, government entities and strategic partners. Drive domestic and international market expansion, where applicable. Oversee tendering, techno-commercial proposals, pricing strategies, contract negotiations and order acquisition. Strengthen customer retention, aftermarket services, spares business and long-term service contracts. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer requirements and emerging technologies to identify new growth avenues. C. Operations & Manufacturing Management Oversee end-to-end operations, manufacturing, production planning, supply chain, procurement, logistics and project execution. Ensure timely delivery of products, equipment and projects in accordance with customer specifications, budgets and contractual commitments. Drive productivity improvement, capacity utilisation, process optimisation and operational excellence. Establish robust systems for production planning, inventory management, vendor development and cost control. Improve coordination between sales, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, quality, finance and service teams. Establish operational dashboards, review mechanisms and performance management systems to monitor business outcomes. D. Technical, Engineering & Product Management Provide strategic leadership to engineering, design, R&D, technical services and product development functions. Oversee design, engineering and manufacturing of crushing and grinding equipment, mineral processing plants, material handling systems and other industrial machinery, as applicable. Ensure technical solutions meet customer specifications, performance requirements, reliability standards and applicable statutory requirements. Drive value engineering, product standardisation, technology upgrades and continuous product improvement. Review critical technical proposals, engineering designs, project risks and major customer-specific requirements. Strengthen technical collaboration with customers, consultants, suppliers and technology partners. Ensure effective commissioning, troubleshooting, warranty management and after-sales technical support. E. Quality Management & Customer Satisfaction Establish and maintain a robust quality management framework across design, procurement, manufacturing, inspection, testing and project delivery. Ensure adherence to approved quality standards, customer specifications, inspection plans and applicable regulatory requirements. Drive defect prevention, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and continuous improvement. Monitor rejection rates, rework, warranty costs, customer complaints and product reliability. Develop a culture of quality ownership and accountability across all functions. Ensure timely closure of customer quality issues and improvement of customer satisfaction. F. EHS, Safety & Environmental Compliance Lead the organisation's Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) strategy and ensure a strong safety-first culture. Ensure compliance with applicable occupational health, industrial safety, environmental and statutory requirements. Oversee risk assessments, safety audits, incident investigations, emergency preparedness and preventive action plans. Monitor workplace safety, environmental performance, waste management and resource efficiency. Establish measurable EHS objectives and review safety performance across manufacturing facilities, project sites and service operations. Ensure accountability of business and functional leaders for safe operations and continuous EHS improvement. G. ISO Systems & Business Excellence Ensure implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of applicable ISO management systems, including:
 ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems. ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems. Oversee internal and external audits, management reviews, non-conformity closure, corrective actions and certification renewals. Ensure documented procedures, SOPs, process controls and records are maintained effectively. Integrate quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management systems into daily business operations. Promote standardisation, risk-based thinking, compliance discipline and a culture of continuous improvement. H. Finance, Governance & Risk Management Work closely with Finance to strengthen budgeting, financial reporting, cost management, credit control and cash-flow planning. Monitor receivables, inventory levels, supplier payments, project profitability and working capital cycles. Ensure appropriate internal controls, delegation of authority, contract governance and risk mitigation mechanisms. Ensure compliance with applicable corporate, tax, labour, environmental and industry-specific statutory requirements. Present periodic business performance reports, strategic updates and risk assessments to the Board and Promoters. I. Leadership, Organisation Development & People Management Build, lead and mentor a high-performing leadership team across Sales, Business Development, Operations, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain and Finance. Define organisational structures, responsibilities, performance objectives and accountability frameworks. Develop succession plans, strengthen leadership capability and build a performance-driven culture. Drive organisational transformation, digitalisation, productivity improvement and change management. Foster collaboration, ethical conduct, customer focus, innovation and ownership at all levels. 3. Manufacturing productivity, capacity utilisation and operating cost reduction. Product quality, rejection rates, rework and warranty costs. EHS performance, incident reduction and statutory compliance. ISO certification status, audit findings and closure of non-conformities. Working capital, cash flow, receivables and inventory control. title: Bookkeeper - US Accounting
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION : Accounting Executive / Senior Accounting Executive 
 Department : Accounting & Finance
 Location : Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
 Shift Timing : 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST
 
 1. Position Summary 
Rang Technologies is looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Accounting Executive / Senior Accounting Executive to join our Accounting & Finance team in Ahmedabad.
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, general ledger scrutiny, and financial reporting. Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO), class-wise accounting, and advanced Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.
The selected candidate will support day-to-day accounting operations, maintain accurate financial records, assist with month-end closing, and prepare financial reports to support management decision-making.
 2. Key Responsibilities 
Accounting Operations & Bookkeeping
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in accordance with accounting principles and company policies. Record and review financial transactions, journal entries, accruals, and adjustments. Perform bank and balance sheet account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Conduct general ledger scrutiny to identify unusual transactions, incorrect classifications, and accounting errors. QuickBooks Online (QBO) & Class-Wise Accounting 
 Manage day-to-day accounting activities using QuickBooks Online. Ensure proper classification and recording of income, expenses, assets, and liabilities. Maintain accurate class-wise accounting records and review financial performance by class. Generate financial reports and ensure consistency between accounting records and supporting documents. Financial Reporting & Management Accounting 
 Assist in preparing monthly financial statements, management reports, and financial summaries. Perform variance analysis and investigate significant fluctuations in income and expenses. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Prepare account schedules and supporting documentation for management review. Excel & Process Improvement 
 Use advanced Microsoft Excel functions, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS, and other relevant formulas. Analyze financial data and prepare accurate reports and reconciliations. Maintain proper documentation and follow internal controls. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, accuracy, and reporting efficiency. Tax & Compliance Support 
 Assist in preparing accounting schedules and supporting documents required for tax filings and statutory compliance. Coordinate with internal teams and external accounting professionals as required. 3. Qualifications & Skills 
 Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Inter-CA or CA Final candidate who has completed the required articleship. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) is preferred. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Good written and verbal communication skills. 4. Preferred Experience 
 Experience working with US accounting and bookkeeping practices. Practical knowledge of class-wise accounting in QuickBooks Online. Experience preparing monthly financial statements and management reports. Exposure to US tax-related accounting documentation and compliance support. Experience handling accounting for multiple entities or business units. 5. Career Opportunity 
This position offers an excellent opportunity for accounting professionals to develop their expertise in US accounting practices, QuickBooks Online, class-wise accounting, financial reporting, and management accounting.
Candidates who are detail-oriented, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership of accounting responsibilities are encouraged to apply.

Key Skills: US Accounting,Book Keeping,Quick Books,Quick,Accounting

title: Operations Manager
description:
Hiring: Operations Manager - International BPO 
 Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only 
 Experience & Eligibility 
 - Minimum 2 years of experience in an Operations Manager or equivalent leadership role within an International BPO. - Overall BPO experience of 6 to 8+ years preferred. - Proven experience managing large teams in an international customer service environment. - Graduate in any discipline (Mandatory). - Strong experience in operational performance management, client interactions, and people leadership. 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a business-driven Operations Manager to manage and optimize day-to-day operations for an International BPO supporting global customer service programs. The ideal candidate will have strong operational leadership, analytical capabilities, client management expertise, and a proven track record of achieving business targets through effective people management and process improvements. 
 The role is responsible for delivering operational excellence, meeting client expectations, improving key performance metrics, developing high-performing teams, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Operational Leadership 
 - Manage day-to-day operations for an International BPO customer service program. - Ensure achievement of key operational metrics, including SLA, Productivity, Quality, CSAT, FCR, AHT, Schedule Adherence, Attendance, and Attrition. - Monitor team and process performance through MIS reports, dashboards, and operational analytics. - Identify performance gaps, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective action plans. - Ensure adherence to client requirements, internal policies, compliance standards, and quality guidelines. - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. 
 2. Client & Stakeholder Management 
 - Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. - Participate in client governance meetings, including Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs). - Present operational performance, business insights, action plans, and improvement initiatives. - Manage client escalations and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. - Collaborate with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, Recruitment, Finance, and IT teams to achieve business objectives. 
 3. Team Leadership & People Development 
 - Lead, coach, and develop Team Managers, Team Leaders, and frontline customer service teams. - Drive employee engagement, performance management, and leadership development initiatives. - Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions. - Identify training needs and implement development plans to improve employee performance. - Monitor attendance, attrition, productivity, and employee engagement while driving retention initiatives. - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 4. Performance Management & Business Excellence 
 - Analyze operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. - Drive performance improvement plans to achieve business targets and service delivery commitments. - Support forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and resource optimization in coordination with Workforce Management. - Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. - Lead process improvement initiatives and support automation where applicable. - Ensure effective implementation of operational changes, client requirements, and business initiatives. 
 5. Reporting & Compliance 
 - Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. - Maintain accurate MIS, performance dashboards, and business review presentations. - Ensure compliance with client-specific requirements, company policies, and operational procedures. - Track action plans and ensure timely closure of performance gaps and escalations. 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 - Strong understanding of International BPO operations and customer service processes. - Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, MIS, and reporting. - Strong client-facing, communication, and stakeholder management skills. - Proven ability to analyze operational data and translate insights into actionable improvements. - Excellent people management, coaching, and team leadership capabilities. - Strong understanding of Workforce Management, Quality, Customer Experience metrics, forecasting, and capacity planning. - Ability to manage escalations, competing priorities, and fast-paced operational environments. - Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and presentation skills. - Demonstrated ownership of operational targets and service delivery performance. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 - Experience supporting international clients across multiple geographies. - Experience managing large teams or high-volume customer service operations. 
 What We're Looking For 
 We are looking for an Operations Manager who: 
 - Takes ownership of operational performance and business outcomes. - Builds strong client relationships and maintains service delivery standards. - Uses data and analytics to drive informed decisions. - Develops, motivates, and retains high-performing teams. - Identifies operational challenges and implements effective solutions. - Consistently delivers business results in a fast-paced International BPO environment. 
 Why Join Us? 
 - Manage high-impact International BPO customer service operations. - Work closely with global clients and cross-functional teams. - Drive operational improvements and contribute to business success. - Develop leadership capabilities and progress in your career.

title: Manager – Fabrication & Operations
description:
About the job Job Purpose To manage and supervise fabrication, marine engineering and project operations at assigned locations. The role involves planning and executing structural fabrication, welding, piping, mechanical work, equipment installation, maintenance and associated engineering activities. The Manager will be responsible for project execution, manpower management, subcontractor coordination, quality, safety, material utilization and timely completion of work as per project requirements. Industry Preference: Experience in any of the following industries will be an added advantage: Shipbuilding & Ship Repair Marine Engineering & Shipyard Services Offshore Engineering & Offshore Fabrication Defence Shipyards & Naval Engineering Heavy Engineering & Industrial Fabrication Port, Floating Structures & Marine Infrastructure Key Responsibilities & Duties Fabrication & Technical Operations Manage day-to-day fabrication and engineering activities at the assigned project location. Supervise structural steelwork, plate cutting, fit-up, welding, assembly, piping and installation activities. Ensure fabrication and assembly work is carried out as per approved drawings, technical specifications and established procedures. Coordinate mechanical work, equipment installation, maintenance, modification and associated engineering activities. Identify technical and operational issues and coordinate with the Engineering team for timely resolution. Ensure proper utilization of machinery, tools, equipment and available resources. Project Planning & Execution Prepare work plans and execution schedules in coordination with Project and Engineering teams. Plan manpower, materials, equipment and subcontractor requirements. Monitor daily progress against project schedules and milestones. Ensure work is completed within agreed timelines and required quality standards. Identify delays, resource constraints and operational bottlenecks and take corrective action. Coordinate multiple work activities to ensure smooth project execution. Manpower & Subcontractor Management Supervise supervisors, welders, fabricators, fitters, technicians and other site personnel. Allocate work and monitor productivity, attendance, workmanship and performance. Manage subcontractors and monitor their work quality, productivity and timely completion. Ensure proper deployment and utilization of manpower according to project requirements. Maintain discipline, accountability and effective coordination among site teams. Quality Control Ensure fabrication, welding, piping, mechanical and installation work meets approved drawings and specified quality standards. Coordinate with the Quality team for inspections, testing and rectification of defects. Monitor workmanship and ensure compliance with technical specifications and approved procedures. Minimize rework, defects, material wastage and avoidable costs. Maintain proper work progress, inspection and completion records. Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with company HSE policies, client requirements and applicable site safety procedures. Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to safe working practices. Monitor safety during welding, gas cutting, lifting, working at height, confined-space activities and other high-risk operations. Coordinate with the HSE team for work permits, toolbox talks and safety inspections. Identify unsafe conditions, report incidents and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Material & Cost Control Coordinate with Stores, Purchase and Project teams to ensure timely availability of materials, tools, equipment and consumables. Monitor material consumption and ensure minimum wastage. Ensure proper utilization and maintenance of machinery, tools and equipment. Identify material shortages and additional resource requirements that may affect project progress. Support management in controlling operational costs and improving productivity. Coordination & Reporting Coordinate with client representatives, Project Management, Engineering, Quality, HSE, Stores and subcontractors. Maintain daily progress reports, manpower deployment records and work completion updates. Report project progress, delays, technical issues and resource requirements to management. Participate in project review meetings and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. Recommend improvements in work methods, productivity, resource utilization and operational efficiency. Qualification Essential Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Preferred Additional technical qualifications or certifications in fabrication, welding, marine engineering or project operations. Experience 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in fabrication, marine engineering, mechanical engineering or project operations. Practical experience in structural steel fabrication, welding, piping, mechanical work and equipment installation. Experience in shipyard, marine, offshore, heavy engineering or similar project-based environments. Proven experience in manpower supervision, subcontractor management and project execution. Experience handling complex engineering activities, site coordination and time-bound project delivery. Knowledge & Skills Strong practical knowledge of structural fabrication, welding, piping and mechanical systems. Understanding of marine engineering and project operations. Ability to read and interpret engineering and fabrication drawings. Strong planning, execution and manpower management skills. Good knowledge of quality control, inspection procedures and industrial safety. Effective communication, coordination and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple activities and meet project deadlines.

Key Skills: Fabrication & Technical Operations,mechanical work,project operations,welding,equipment installation,marine engineering,manpower management,piping

About us: 
 Aakhani Solutions is a Mumbai-based company specializing in mechanized spray plaster application for large construction projects. We work with leading construction and infrastructure companies across Maharashtra and other states, and we are growing. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run day-to-day site operations and keep our projects on time, on budget and profitable. 
 Role Overview You will be the single point of responsibility for our project operations. You will manage site supervisors, plan manpower for incoming orders, handle client-side site relationships, and make sure billing and collections stay on schedule. You will work closely with our sales and machine operations teams, but you will not be responsible for lead generation or machine maintenance. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage and guide site supervisors, and plan day-to-day work across multiple project sites Coordinate with the machine operations team to resolve equipment issues quickly and follow up until closure Work with the sales team to understand upcoming orders, their timing and scale, and plan manpower accordingly Source and onboard application teams, and decide applicable wages and labour rates Build and maintain strong working relationships with client project managers, site managers, and accounts and billing staff Ensure site supervisors submit measurements and bills on time, and keep billing cycles up to date Personally step in to resolve site issues that supervisors cannot handle Track site-level cost and profitability, and keep management informed of key developments Ensure quality, safety and timely completion on all sites

 Good to have: Experience in finishing works (plaster, putty, waterproofing, tiling or gypsum) Experience with large EPC or infrastructure clients Experience sourcing and managing labour teams across locations

description:
Greetings for the day!! 
 We are in search of the right resource for a Head- Franchise Operations to be associated with a leading furniture organization, based out in Mumbai. 
 Job Title : Head- Franchise Operations
 Location: Mumbai 
 Role Overview We are looking for a seasoned, commercially driven leader to head the company's franchise operations and business performance. The role will be responsible for driving revenue growth, improving franchisee profitability, strengthening partner relationships, and ensuring operational excellence across the franchise store neftwork. 
 The individual will own the franchise business after onboarding, ensuring that every store delivers sustainable growth, a strong customer experience, and consistent brand and operational standards. A key priority will be to build the team, systems, and processes required to scale the franchise network several-fold. Key Responsibilities 1. Revenue Growth and Business Performance Own the annual revenue and sales targets for the franchise channel, with clear targets for each region and store. Drive same-store sales growth through franchisee coaching, local marketing, product mix optimisation, and merchandising improvements. Conduct regular business reviews with franchise partners and implement measurable action plans. Identify underperforming stores and lead structured performance improvement and turnaround initiatives. Ensure new stores achieve targeted sales within agreed ramp-up timelines. 2. Franchisee Relationship Management and Profitability Serve as the primary senior point of contact for franchise partners after onboarding. Build long-term, trust-based relationships with franchise owners through regular engagement, reviews, and store visits. Review store-level profitability and P&L performance, helping franchisees improve margins, productivity, and overall business health. Proactively address partner concerns, resolve disputes, and manage escalations effectively. Monitor franchisee satisfaction and take preventive action to minimise partner attrition and store exits. Provide business and operational inputs on prospective franchisee suitability, in coordination with Business Development. 3. Order Fulfilment and Customer Experience Ensure timely and complete fulfilment of franchisee orders in coordination with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Logistics. Drive high standards of installation, after-sales service, and customer experience across franchise locations. Monitor customer complaints and service requests through to resolution within defined service-level agreements. Work cross-functionally to identify root causes of recurring fulfilment and service issues and implement corrective actions. 4. Receivables and Commercial Management Own franchise channel collections and ensure payments are received within agreed credit terms. Work closely with Finance and Accounts to reconcile franchisee accounts and resolve outstanding discrepancies. Monitor overdue receivables and implement corrective actions to maintain healthy cash flow. Ensure compliance with company pricing, discounting, credit, and commercial policies. 5. Store Operations and Brand Standards Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines, visual merchandising, store presentation, and operating procedures. Monitor inventory availability, stock health, replenishment, and ordering practices at franchise stores. Ensure store teams are adequately trained in product knowledge, selling skills, customer service, and company processes. Resolve operational issues raised by franchise partners and store teams. Develop scalable SOPs, operating checklists, performance dashboards, and review mechanisms to support network expansion. 6. Team Leadership and Network Scalability Build, lead, and develop a team of regional Area Managers to manage the franchise network effectively. Set clear performance objectives, review results, and coach team members to improve execution. Plan team structure, hiring, and capability development in line with network expansion. Establish a disciplined performance management cadence across regions and stores. Develop standardised operating processes and management systems that enable the business to scale without compromising service or profitability. 7. Additional Scope Depending on the final organisational structure, the role may also oversee the dealer/distribution channel, including secondary sales, dealer relationships, order management, collections, and service coordination. Dealer acquisition would remain the responsibility of Business Development. 
 Candidate Profile Education Graduate in any discipline is mandatory. MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Operations is preferred. Experience 15+ years of relevant experience in retail, franchise operations, or channel management. At least 5 years of experience leading a multi-city or regional network. Demonstrated experience managing franchisees, dealers, distributors, or other channel partners. A proven track record of growing sales, improving partner profitability, and scaling retail networks and teams.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
## Key Responsibilities

### Business & Sales Performance

* Own and drive the overall sales and business performance of the assigned cluster.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets across the cluster.
* Monitor store-wise sales, conversion, average transaction value, productivity, and other key retail KPIs.
* Identify gaps in store performance and implement effective action plans.
* Drive business growth through local market opportunities, customer initiatives, and sales strategies.
* Ensure consistent achievement of store and cluster-level targets.

### Multi-Store Retail Operations

* Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple Just In Time stores across Ahmedabad.
* Conduct regular store visits to ensure operational discipline and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure consistent execution of SOPs, visual merchandising, grooming, customer service, and brand standards.
* Monitor store hygiene, presentation, processes, and compliance.
* Coordinate with HO teams including HR, Operations, VM, Inventory, Finance, and Marketing to resolve store-level challenges.
* Support new store launches and ensure smooth operational setup.

### Store Manager Leadership

* Lead, coach, and mentor Store Managers across the assigned cluster.
* Set clear performance expectations and review Store Manager performance regularly.
* Develop Store Managers into strong business and people leaders.
* Identify capability gaps and coordinate with the training team for development interventions.
* Ensure Store Managers effectively manage their teams, targets, customer experience, and store operations.
* Build a strong performance-driven culture across the cluster.

### Manpower & Team Management

* Ensure adequate manpower availability across stores in coordination with HR and Talent Acquisition.
* Support manpower planning based on store productivity and business requirements.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, attrition, and retention.
* Identify high-potential employees and support internal career development.
* Ensure effective onboarding and training of new team members.

### Customer Experience

* Ensure a consistently premium customer experience across all stores.
* Monitor customer feedback and address escalated customer concerns.
* Ensure teams maintain high standards of grooming, product knowledge, selling skills, and customer engagement.
* Drive customer retention and relationship-building initiatives.

### Inventory & Store Controls

* Monitor stock availability and ensure optimum inventory levels across stores.
* Coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams for stock movement and requirements.
* Monitor stock ageing, fast-moving and slow-moving products, and inventory-related gaps.
* Ensure adherence to company processes related to stock, cash, billing, and store controls.
* Identify and escalate operational risks or discrepancies promptly.

### Market & Competitor Understanding

* Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
* Understand the competitive retail environment across Ahmedabad.
* Identify opportunities for improving store performance and strengthening Just In Time's market presence.
* Share relevant market insights and recommendations with senior management.

### Reporting & Review

* Prepare and present regular cluster performance updates to senior management.
* Track store-wise sales, targets, productivity, manpower, conversion, inventory, and other relevant KPIs.
* Conduct regular reviews with Store Managers and follow up on agreed action plans.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations for improving cluster performance.

## Requirements & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in retail sales and operations.
* Strong experience in managing multiple stores / a retail cluster.
* Experience managing and developing Store Managers and large retail teams.
* Proven experience in achieving sales targets and improving store productivity.
* Strong understanding of retail KPIs, sales conversion, ATV, UPT, productivity, and customer experience.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong analytical and business acumen.
* Experience in premium/luxury retail, watches, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or other high-value retail categories will be preferred.
* Willingness to travel across Ahmedabad and nearby locations as required.

## Key Success Measures

* Cluster sales achievement
* Store-wise target achievement
* Store productivity and conversion
* Average Transaction Value (ATV) and UPT
* Store Manager performance
* Customer experience and service standards
* Team stability and attrition
* Inventory and operational controls
* New store launch and ramp-up performance

Key Skills: Retail Operations,Store Operations,multi store,Operations,Stores,Store Operation,Retail,Cluster Management
